entries.title: Gothic Girl Sword Dance Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed 15-second cinematic video prompt for Grok Imagine featuring a gothic girl performing a sword dance with Japanese katana, set against autumn leaves, including specific scene breakdowns and audio instructions.
entries.prompt:
@Image1、@Image2、@Image3の少女の顔立ち、ピンクブロンドのロングヘア、紫の瞳、黒のレースヘッドドレスとチョーカー、黒と紫のエナメル・レース素材のゴシックドレスの衣装、日本刀、および秋の紅葉並木道の背景の一貫性を厳密に維持しながら、リズミカルで華麗な剣舞を披露する15秒のシネマティック動画。

【BGM・音響】
和楽器(三味線・和太鼓・尺八)と重厚で疾走感のあるデジタルビートが融合した、剣舞に合うドラマチックでリズミカルな和風ロック・エレクトロニカ。刀が風を切る鋭い風切り音や、静止時の静寂のメリハリが効いた音響。

【シーン1(0:00〜0:04)ミディアムショット/基準:@Image1】
画面は@Image1の構図から始まる。少女は凛とした表情で日本刀を鞘から一気に抜き放ち、前へ鋭く踏み込みながら斜め袈裟斬りを放つ(1振り目)。続けて素早く反転し、刀身を水平に閃かせる高速の横薙ぎを繰り出した瞬間、ピタッと動きを止めて鋭い眼差しで残心を決める(2振り目)。

【シーン2(0:04〜0:08)バストアップ/基準:@Image2】
カメラは@Image2の距離感へ切り替わる。静寂から一転、少女は顔まわりで刀を回転させるような目にも止まらぬ高速の連続切り返しを披露し、髪の毛とヘッドドレスのレースが激しく舞う(1振り目)。その後、激しい動きから急にスピードを落とし、刀の切っ先で空中に優雅な弧を描くように滑らかで流麗な軌道へと移行し、艶やかに舞う(2振り目)。

【シーン3(0:08〜0:12)ミディアムショット/基準:@Image3】
画面は@Image3のミディアムアングルへ戻る。少女は軽やかなステップでリズムに乗りながら、ドレスのフリルを翻して華麗に一回転し、低い姿勢から鋭い斬り上げを放つ(1振り目)。そのまま勢いを殺さずに頭上で刀を風車のように高速回転させ、再びピタッと静止してクールな決めポーズと残心をとる(2振り目)。

【シーン4(0:12〜0:15)ラスト・決めポーズ/基準:@Image2】
再び@Image2に近い印象的なアングルへとズームイン。少女はフィニッシュとして刀を斜め前に優雅に構え直す流麗な納刀前の決めポーズをとる(1振り目)。直後、凛々しい表情から一転して愛らしい微笑みを浮かべ、カメラに向かって右目だけでキュートにウインクをして余韻を残しながら締めくくる。

【映像品質】
高精細、滑らかなモーション、自然な布と髪の物理演算、紅葉の木漏れ日が刀身に反射する美しいライティング、破綻のない指と刀の保持。
entries.translated_prompt:
A 15-second cinematic video of a girl maintaining strict consistency with @Image1, @Image2, and @Image3 regarding her facial features, pink-blonde long hair, purple eyes, black lace headdress and choker, gothic dress made of black and purple enamel/lace materials, Japanese katana, and the background of an autumn maple-lined path, while performing a rhythmic and magnificent sword dance.

[BGM & Sound]
Dramatic and rhythmic Japanese-style rock/electronica fusing traditional instruments (shamisen, taiko drums, shakuhachi) with heavy, fast-paced digital beats suitable for sword dancing. Sharp sound effects of the blade cutting through the air and well-defined silence during stillness.

[Scene 1 (0:00-0:04) Medium Shot / Reference: @Image1]
The screen starts from the composition of @Image1. With a dignified expression, the girl swiftly draws the Japanese katana from its sheath, steps forward sharply, and delivers a diagonal slash (1st swing). She then quickly turns around and executes a high-speed horizontal sweep flashing the blade horizontally, stopping abruptly at the moment of release to hold a sharp gaze in zanshin (awareness after attack) (2nd swing).

[Scene 2 (0:04-0:08) Bust Up / Reference: @Image2]
The camera switches to the distance sense of @Image2. From silence, the girl suddenly performs rapid consecutive cuts spinning the sword around her face, making her hair and headdress lace flutter wildly (1st swing). Then, she slows down from intense movement, transitioning smoothly into a graceful arc traced by the tip of the sword in mid-air, dancing elegantly (2nd swing).

[Scene 3 (0:08-0:12) Medium Shot / Reference: @Image3]
The screen returns to the medium angle of @Image3. Riding the rhythm with light steps, the girl flips her dress frills and spins beautifully once, delivering a sharp upward slash from a low stance (1st swing). Without killing the momentum, she rotates the sword rapidly above her head like a windmill, stops again abruptly to strike a cool pose and zanshin (2nd swing).

[Scene 4 (0:12-0:15) Last Pose / Reference: @Image2]
Zoom in again to an impressive angle similar to @Image2. As a finish, the girl takes a flowing pre-sheathing pose, gracefully re-holding the sword diagonally forward (1st swing). Immediately after, shifting from a brave expression to a cute smile, she winks cutely with just one eye towards the camera, ending with lingering atmosphere.

[Video Quality]
High definition, smooth motion, natural physics simulation for cloth and hair, beautiful lighting where sunlight filtering through maple leaves reflects off the blade, flawless finger and sword grip.

Generate a continuous video of a futuristic heavy-duty truck racing along a mountain highway, then transforming into a towering Optimus-style giant warrior. The core subject is the red-and-blue truck, and the principal event is its high-speed drive followed by a detailed mechanical transformation into the bipedal robot form.

[Reference Asset Roles]
@image1 is used for the truck's overall appearance, red cab with blue flame-like markings, blue shipping container with red graffiti, chrome exhaust stacks, headlights, wheels, and the golden-hour mountain road scene under dramatic cloudy skies; do not invent extra people or vehicles.
@image2 is used for the final giant warrior's design: red-and-blue armored plating, chrome mechanical details, blue glowing eyes, chest windows, wheel-like feet, and overall Optimus-inspired silhouette; the mountain sunset landscape in @image2 may reinforce lighting and environment continuity.

[Subjects and Relationships]
The single truck from @image1 is the only vehicle and is the exact same entity that transforms into the single giant warrior from @image2. No additional trucks, robots, or characters appear. The road, grassy hills, distant snow-capped mountains, and dramatic cloudy sky remain consistent throughout.

[Event Script]
At the start: the red-cab truck with blue container races toward the camera along the asphalt highway, headlights on, engine roaring, wheels spinning, and wind rushing past under the golden sunset light with heavy clouds.
Principal event: the truck continues at high speed for a short beat, then begins a precise, realistic transformation. Every wheel, panel, engine block, exhaust stack, trailer container, and mechanicals joint unfolds, rotates, and reconfigures with intricate, weighty motion. The cab rises and becomes the torso and head, the trailer sections form the limbs and armor plates, wheels become feet, and chrome components lock into place until the towering Optimus-style warrior stands fully upright on the same road.
At the end: the giant warrior stands tall and stable on the highway facing the viewer, blue eyes glowing, red-and-blue armor complete, with the mountain landscape and sunset light still surrounding it; the original truck form no longer exists as a vehicle.

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep the exact red-and-blue color scheme, flame/graffiti markings, chrome details, and mechanical aesthetics continuous from truck to robot. Preserve the single-entity identity so the warrior is unmistakably the transformed truck. Maintain the mountain highway environment, golden-hour lighting, dramatic cloudy sky, and realistic scale of the transformation. All mechanical movements remain precise, heavy, and physically believable with no abrupt jumps or missing parts.

供暖解压 legato——冷闪、屏息、一次奶油般融化推开、水珠顺滑、安静暖意收住。

0:02-0:04：同轴、同一层霜。画面下方已露出暖气片上沿；暖黄尘粒与热浪丝带自该上沿连续上升。热在升，上方马群霜影仍完整——无融化锋、无滴水、无阀门管件。拍末短短屏息。
音效：柔和暖气哼鸣

0:04-0:07：同轴锁死。下缘先读出一道有机融化锋，再像粘稠奶油般连续上爬——锋尖逐帧真位移，同一条锯齿齿尖连续爬升，绝不是水平条整块上台阶，也绝不是瞬间化光，也绝不是一条亮边横扫 wipe；马形随霜带变薄自然消解，绝不单独「保马形不化」或整块瞬消。锋下展开湿亮玻璃，身后拖着水膜高光。暖气片上沿只作暖色金属条停在画面底边，轮廓随湿玻璃可读性减弱而变淡——绝不变形、不发光成灯、不化成珠。本拍末，同一块玻璃上已有水膜与成形水珠。
音效：柔和融化轻嘶；早期水珠轻点

0:07-0:09：同一块连续湿玻璃、同一光。清澈近圆水珠成细流重力下滑，或先轻颤再滑——路径连续，绝不是整条水痕瞬现。镜面高光随水流滚动。动势收成极慢珠滑 + 高光微滚；锋尖几乎停但仍有亚像素蠕动——全程禁止冻结成静帧感。无新化、无回冻。
音效：水珠轻点 → 短静

0:09-0:10：同一块连续湿玻璃。光学轻推不超过 8% 咬向透光区；霜留下不规则有机残尖与硬湿边缘横贯下半——绝不是整齐宽横条、绝不是椭圆窥视洞，也绝不是残留的完整马形贴纸；残霜不再可读成完整马形。钠黄暖街灯透过水汽清晰可读；看到暖意即停。
音效：安静房间底噪

风格：写实微距解压，湿玻璃物理，冷暖对峙，一条过；马群仅作霜晶自然剪影感，不追求可数七骏。

反向：热起来之前不要化；不要水平条台阶式融化；不要亮边横扫 wipe；不要瞬间化光；不要水珠/水痕瞬现；化后不要干哑玻璃；末段不要近静冻结；不要跳轴；不要第二扇窗；不要椭圆窥视洞；不要整齐宽横残带；不要黄铜阀或管件；不要暖气片变形成街景虚化；不要贴纸马/卡通马/刻出来的完整马形；不要融化时单独保马形不化；不要逐匹清晰可数的七骏刻形；不要人手、枫叶、木槌、神像；不要音乐或对白。
entries.translated_prompt:
Subject:
Interior night view through single-pane glass: Dense wet cold frost crystals naturally form a vague silhouette of a herd of horses (approx. several, not clearly countable individually) — still real frost crystal luster, not sticker horses or carved horse shapes. Starts fully unmelted; first frame is pure frost without showing the radiator top edge. Overall readable as a horse silhouette tendency, but edges are all fern-like/branch-like crystal fuzz, not aiming for 'clearly counting seven horses'. After about two seconds, the top edge of the radiator appears at the bottom of the screen; heat wave dust rises from the lower edge, driving a continuous viscous melt: the same organic front line climbs frame-by-frame from bottom to top, the front is the same jagged tooth tip climbing, tooth spacing changes continuously, absolutely not a bright edge sweeping across the picture; behind it leaves a readable wet mirror-like water film, followed by clear nearly round water droplets sliding down the same glass due to gravity. Where the frost retreats, a shield of sodium-yellow warm street light outside the window shines through. No human hands, maple leaves, mallets, idols, or figures; no brass valves or pipe fittings close-ups.

Environment:
9:16 extreme macro locked onto a piece of glass, slightly overhead, coaxial throughout. When frost is complete, outside is cold blue night; warm yellow seeps near the radiator top edge; after frost retreats, warm street lights shine through wet glass. Do not cut to another window.

Mood:
Heating decompression legato — cold flash, breath holding, one creamy melt push, smooth water droplets, quiet warmth settling.

Sound: Say once for the whole segment — frost surface hiss, heater hum, melt hiss, water drop tap, quiet room noise; no music, no dialogue.

Timeline:
0:00-0:02: Locked extreme close-up, coaxial. Wet cold frost crystals immediately fill the screen, vaguely reading as horse silhouettes against deep blue; no radiator at the bottom yet. Only motion: wet cold glow slowly crawling along crystal edges — crystals remain solid; silhouette tendency does not drift or morph into other animals, but don't require individual clarity. No dripping, no heat, no radiator top edge shown.
SFX: Faint ice frost hiss

0:02-0:04: Coaxial, same layer of frost. Top edge of radiator now visible at bottom; warm yellow dust particles and heat wave ribbons rise continuously from that edge. Heat rises, upper horse frost shadows remain complete — no melt front, no dripping, no valve pipes. Short breath hold at end of shot.
SFX: Soft heater hum

0:04-0:07: Coaxial lock. Bottom edge first reads an organic melt front, then climbs continuously like sticky cream — front tip truly displaces frame-by-frame, same jagged tooth tip climbing continuously, absolutely not horizontal step-wise block melting, absolutely not instant light dissipation, absolutely not a bright edge sweep wipe; horse shapes dissolve naturally as frost thins, absolutely not keeping horse shape unmelted separately or whole block vanishing instantly. Under the front, wet bright glass expands, trailing water film highlights. Radiator top edge stays only as a warm metal strip at the bottom edge, outline fades as wet glass readability decreases — absolutely not deforming, glowing into a lamp, or turning into beads. At end of this shot, same glass has water film and formed droplets.
SFX: Soft melt hiss; early water drop taps

0:07-0:09: Same continuous wet glass, same light. Clear nearly round water droplets form thin streams sliding down due to gravity, or tremble lightly before sliding — path is continuous, absolutely not entire water trail appearing instantly. Mirror highlights roll with water flow. Momentum settles into extremely slow slide + highlight micro-roll; front tip almost stops but still has sub-pixel creep — prohibit freezing into static feel throughout. No new melting, no refreezing.
SFX: Water drop tap -> short silence

0:09-0:10: Same continuous wet glass. Optical slight push no more than 8% bites into transparent area; frost leaves irregular organic residual tips and hard wet edges crossing lower half — absolutely not neat wide horizontal band, absolutely not elliptical peephole, absolutely not remaining complete horse shape sticker; residual frost no longer readable as complete horse shape. Sodium-yellow warm street light clearly readable through water vapor; stop upon seeing warmth.
SFX: Quiet room noise

Style: Realistic macro decompression, wet glass physics, cold-warm confrontation, one take; horse group only as natural frost crystal silhouette feeling, do not pursue countable seven horses.

Negative: Do not melt before heating starts; no horizontal step-wise melting; no bright edge sweep wipe; no instant light dissipation; no instant appearance of droplets/water trails; no dry matte glass after melting; no near-static freeze in final segment; no axis jumping; no second window; no elliptical peephole; no neat wide residual band; no brass valves or pipe fittings; no radiator deforming into blurred street scene; no sticker/cartoon/carved complete horse shapes; no keeping horse shape unmelted during melting; no clearly countable seven horse carvings; no human hands, maple leaves, mallets, idols; no music or dialogue.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Female Red-Blue Optimus Prime Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for Grok Imagine to create a sci-fi transformation video where a woman turns into a female version of Optimus Prime with the classic red and blue color scheme.
entries.prompt:
[Generation Goal]
Generate a high-energy next-level Sci-Fi transformation video. The core subject is a woman who transforms herself into a same-color Optimus Prime.

[Event Script]
At the start: A powerful woman stands centered in a dark industrial Sci-Fi hangar, sparks and blue energy particles drifting around her. She activates the transformation, her body locking into a rigid stance as glowing seams and geometric plates of light appear across her skin and clothing.
Principal event: Her form expands and restructures with cascading mechanical assemblies. Armor panels of the exact same color as Optimus Prime (red and blue with silver accents) unfold and lock into place over her body. Her head reconstructs into the iconic Optimus Prime helmet, chest into the truck grille and Autobot insignia, arms and legs into heavy robotic limbs, all retaining the same red-blue-silver color scheme. Transformation energy surges outward in waves of light and plasma. The sequence peaks as the final pieces snap shut.
At the end: She stands fully transformed as a same-color female Optimus Prime — towering, heroic silhouette, headlights glowing, chest grille complete, Autobot symbol lit. She raises one arm in a commanding victory pose while residual energy crackles around her.

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep her original identity continuity through the transformation, the exact same red-blue-silver Optimus color scheme throughout, no gender or silhouette drift after completion, continuous energy particle effects, and the industrial Sci-Fi hangar environment stable.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Asuna Cosplay Video Prompt
entries.description: A video prompt for Grok Imagine featuring a character in Asuna-style cosplay. Generated via Gemini instructions, it outlines a 15-second sequence with 4 scenes focusing on upper body movements and a final wink.
entries.prompt:
🎬 Gemini監督への指示
アップロードした3枚の画像（全身、アップ、ミディアム）を上手く使って4シーンの切り替えて「画像のシチュエーションの要素を元に上半身に動きのある映えるポージングを4秒毎（1シーン内で2ポージング）に変える」、15秒(4シーン目は3秒）の動画の日本語プロンプトを作ってください。最後はクローズアップして決めポーズで片目でウインクさせてください。BGMは温かみのあるアコースティックギターと、落ち着いたアコースティックピアノの柔らかいアコースティックな感じ。

人物の顔や髪型は一貫性を維持させてください。画像生成や動画生成は不要。

プロンプト中の画像1(全身)は@Image1、画像2(アップ)は@Image2、画像3(ミディアム)は@Image3 に置き換えてください。

🎥 動画プロンプト（Grok Imagine）
【全体設定・一貫性】
 * 人物・衣装: @Image1（全身）、@Image2（アップ）、@Image3（ミディアム）の女性。顔・髪型・ファンタジー風衣装の一貫性を完全維持。
 * BGM: 温かみのあるアコースティックギターと落ち着いたアコースティックピアノの柔らかいサウンド。
 * 全体の動き: 上半身を中心に動きのあるポーズを展開。
【シーン構成】
 * シーン1（0〜4秒 / 全身・@Image1ベース）
   * 0〜2秒: ドア枠に手を添えた状態から、カメラに向かって優しく微笑み首をかしげる。
   * 2〜4秒: 腰の剣の柄に軽く手を当て、胸を張って凛としたポーズをとる。
 * シーン2（4〜8秒 / ミディアム・@Image3ベース）
   * 4〜6秒: 胸の前で手を重ね、首を少し傾けて柔らかく微笑む。
   * 6〜8秒: 片手で髪をすっとかき上げ、目線をカメラに向け直す。
 * シーン3（8〜12秒 / バストアップ・@Image2ベース）
   * 8〜10秒: カメラに向かって顔の横で小さく手を振る。
   * 10〜12秒: 指先を顎に当てて思案する表情から、パッと華やかな笑顔に変化させる。
 * シーン4（12〜15秒 / クローズアップ・決めポーズ）
   * 12〜15秒: カメラに急接近して顔のクローズアップへ。手でハートまたはピースを作りながら、片目でキュートにウインクして静止。

動画全体のテーマ・構成

BGM
 * 提案: しっとりとしたアコースティックギターとピアノによる、温かみのあるチル系Lo-Fiヒップホップ／アコースティックサウンド（雨上がりの落ち着いた街並みに合う穏やかな楽曲）。

【カット詳細】
カット1（00:00 - 00:06）
 * ベース画像: @Image1
 * ロケーション: 公園のベンチ（紅葉した落ち葉のある風景）
 * 動作・ポーズ:
   * ポーズ1（0〜3秒）: @Image1 の状態からスタート。ベンチに腰掛け、少し伏し目で静かに静止している。
   * ポーズ2（3〜6秒）: ふとカメラ（あるいは前方）に視線を向け、柔らかく微笑みながらメガネのフレームを少し直す動作。
カット2（00:06 - 00:12）
 * ベース画像: @Image2
 * ロケーション: 街角の歩道（雨上がりのビル街）
 * 動作・ポーズ:
   * ポーズ1（6〜9秒）: @Image2 の状態からスタート。透明な傘を差しながら街角に立ち、カメラを見つめる。
   * ポーズ2（9〜12秒）: 傘を少し傾けながらゆっくりと歩き出し、振り返って微笑みながらカメラに向かって小さく手を振る。

- Subtle head movement and slight smile from Elon
- Soft light beams slowly shifting

entries.title: Cyberpunk Body Horror Transformation Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a cyberpunk body-horror transformation scene in a neon megacity alley.
entries.prompt:
A lone figure stands in a rain-soaked neon alley deep in a dystopian megacity at night. Towering holographic billboards flicker overhead with corrupted advertisements while endless streams of vehicles streak past on elevated highways. The figure’s body begins a next-level, hyper-realistic transformation: skin splits and peels back in wet, organic layers as black carbon-fiber plates and exposed chrome biomechanics violently erupt from underneath. Flesh and circuitry fuse in real time — tendons rewiring into fiber-optic cables, eyes flooding with liquid metal and splitting into multiple glowing irises, jaw unhinging as teeth morph into a shifting mechanical maw. Blood and coolant spray in slow motion under harsh neon pink and cyan light. The camera is pure cinematic: low-angle tracking shot that pushes in aggressively, then circles the subject as the transformation accelerates into full body horror — limbs elongating, spine fracturing and reforming into a segmented mechanical exoskeleton, face collapsing into a nightmarish hybrid of human and machine. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, heavy rain droplets on the lens, volumetric fog, and hyper-detailed photorealistic textures (wet skin, reflective metal, torn fabric, glowing circuitry). Dark, oppressive atmosphere with a rising industrial drone and distorted human screams echoing through the alley. Ultra-realistic, filmic, 35mm, high detail, no stylization.

**Shorter / Alternative version (more visceral):**

Photorealistic cinematic body-horror cyberpunk transformation in a rain-drenched neon megacity alley. A person’s body violently rewrites itself in real time — skin tearing open as chrome endoskeleton and black biomechanical plating force their way out, face distorting into a multi-eyed mechanical horror while organic and synthetic tissue fuse and pulse. Extreme close-ups of wet flesh splitting, fiber-optic veins glowing under cyan and magenta light, limbs cracking and reforming. Slow, deliberate camera push-in with anamorphic flares, shallow depth of field, heavy atmosphere, and pure dread. Hyper-realistic textures, cinematic lighting, no cartoonish or stylized elements.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Motorcycle to Tesla Transformation
entries.description: A prompt for a sci-fi cyberpunk video where two motorcycles collide and transform into a flying Tesla Cybertruck.
entries.prompt:
Two helmeted riders on massive armored bikes race toward each other on a rain-soaked neon runway at night. They collide in a violent high-speed impact. Immediately after the crash, both bikes begin a dramatic mechanical transformation and fuse together into one heavy Tesla Cybertruck-style vehicle. The newly formed Tesla ignites thrusters and lifts off the runway, flying into the stormy cyberpunk sky.

Cinematic photorealistic next-level Transformers sci-fi cyberpunk sequence, ultra-detailed, IMAX-style, 4K. Nighttime on a wet futuristic airport runway under heavy rain, with a glowing neon megacity skyline in the background featuring holographic ads, flying vehicles, and cyberpunk atmosphere.

Two massive, heavily armored cyberpunk motorcycles (dark matte black with exposed chrome hydraulics, glowing cyan and magenta energy lines, intricate Transformers-style mechanical detailing) speed toward each other from opposite ends of the runway. Both riders wear full-face high-tech helmets with reflective visors and subtle HUD glow, bodies leaned aggressively forward as tires spray water and engines roar.

They collide head-on in a brutal, high-impact crash at the center of the frame — metal crumples, sparks explode, energy arcs crackle, and debris flies in slow motion. Right after the impact, both bikes begin a spectacular mechanical transformation sequence: panels shift and lock, components reconfigure with hydraulic precision, glowing seams light up, and the two wrecked bikes fuse and reassemble into a single massive heavy Tesla Cybertruck-inspired vehicle — angular, industrial, matte black with brushed metal surfaces and red accent lighting.

The newly formed Tesla powers up, its undercarriage thrusters ignite with bright blue-white plasma, and it lifts powerfully off the runway. It banks and accelerates forward into the rainy night sky, leaving trails of light, steam, and water spray as the neon city stretches below.

Dynamic camera work: low tracking shots following the bikes, dramatic crash close-up with debris flying toward the lens, then a rising aerial pull-back as the Tesla transforms and takes off. Volumetric lighting, heavy rain streaks, lens flares from neon and thrusters, photorealistic metal, water, sparks, and particle effects. Epic high-energy mood with cinematic color grading (deep blues, neon magentas, warm engine glows).

entries.description: A prompt for generating a 15-second video of a cosplayer changing poses every 3 seconds at Comiket, using multiple reference images for consistency.
entries.prompt:
🎬 Gemini監督への指示
アップロードした3枚の画像（全身、アップ、ミディアム）を上手く使って5シーンの切り替えて「コミケ会場でコスプレイヤーが撮影会に決めポーズや映えるポージングを3秒毎（1シーン内で2ポージング）に変える」、15秒の動画の日本語プロンプトを作ってください。最後はクローズアップして決めポーズで片目でウインクさせてください。

BGM「（画像の雰囲気に合ったBGMを考えて）」

人物の顔や髪型は一貫性を維持させてください。画像生成や動画生成は不要。

プロンプト中の画像1(全身)は@Image1、画像2(アップ)は@Image2、画像3(ミディアム)は@Image3 に置き換えてください。

🎥 動画生成プロンプト（Grok Imagine）
【基本設定・一貫性】
 * 人物・衣装の参照: @Image1（全身）、@Image2（アップ）、@Image3（ミディアム）の女性コスプレイヤー。銀髪の三つ編みヘアー、エルフ耳、青と白のファンタジー衣装、顔立ちおよび髪型の一貫性を維持。
 * ロケーション: 賑わうコミケ会場（背景にカメラマンや展示ブースのボケ感）。
 * BGM提案: 爽やかで明るいアップテンポなEDM／アニソン風ポップス（ファンタジー感のあるキラキラしたシンセ音入り）。
【タイムライン・構成（全15秒）】
 * シーン1（0:00 - 0:03）/ 参照: @Image1
   * 画角: フルショット（全身）
   * ポーズ1（0〜1.5秒）: 衣装のスカートを軽く持ち上げて優雅におじぎをするようなポーズ。
   * ポーズ2（1.5〜3秒）: 両手を広げて華やかに微笑み、全身の衣装を見せるポーズ。
 * シーン2（0:03 - 0:06）/ 参照: @Image3
   * 画角: ミディアムショット（腰上）
   * ポーズ1（3〜4.5秒）: 胸の前で両手でハートマークを作り、首を少し傾けて微笑む。
   * ポーズ2（4.5〜6秒）: 片手を顎に当て、カメラを目線で追いかけながらクールな表情を作る。
 * シーン3（0:06 - 0:09）/ 参照: @Image1
   * 画角: アングルを変えたフルショット（斜め全身）
   * ポーズ1（6〜7.5秒）: 身体を斜めにひねり、髪に軽く手を添えて振り返るポーズ。
   * ポーズ2（7.5〜9秒）: 片足を一歩前に出し、ファンタジー作品のヒロイン風に手をカメラへ差し出すポーズ。
 * シーン4（0:09 - 0:12）/ 参照: @Image3
   * 画角: ミディアムショット
   * ポーズ1（9〜10.5秒）: 両手を頬に添えて、驚いたような可愛らしいポーズ。
   * ポーズ2（10.5〜12秒）: カメラに向かって爽やかに手を振るポーズ。
 * シーン5（0:12 - 0:15）/ 参照: @Image2
   * 画角: クローズアップ（顔〜肩上）
   * ポーズ1（12〜13.5秒）: カメラをじっと見つめ、優しく微笑む。
   * ポーズ2（13.5〜15秒）: カメラに向かって決めポーズを取り、片目で可愛らしくウインクして笑顔で静止。

entries.title: VHS Lake Monster Found Footage
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video prompt simulating 1990s camcorder footage of a lake monster attacking a family, complete with VHS artifacts and specific camera movements.
entries.prompt:
1990s camcorder found footage, VHS tape artifacts, tracking lines, chromatic aberration, auto-focus hunting, overexposed highlights, shaky amateur handheld camera, a date timestamp burned into the corner. Color grade: washed out gray-green, faded skin tones, blown out pale sky.
A colossal dark lake creature with a ridged back and a long neck, mostly seen in silhouette through fog. A family on a wooden dock with a canoe at a northern lake.
SHOT 1 (0 to 3s): Wide handheld shot matching the reference image, the camera zooms in clumsily as the creature's back breaks the surface far out on the lake, water rolling off in sheets.
SHOT 2 (3 to 6s): Handheld medium shot, the camera whips toward the family on the dock, a child pointing, a father pulling the canoe out of the water, the image glitching with tracking lines.
SHOT 3 (6 to 9s): Wide shot, auto-focus hunting, the long neck rises out of the fog, impossibly tall, a wave rolling toward the dock.
SHOT 4 (9 to 12s): Running handheld shot, the camera bouncing as the operator flees up the wooden stairs, the lake visible in flashes behind, the wave slamming into the dock.
SHOT 5 (12 to 15s): Static shot, the camera dropped on the grass and tilted sideways, the creature's silhouette slowly sinking back into the fog, then the tape glitches to blue screen.
Loons calling, tape hiss, wind on the microphone, a deep foghorn-like call from the lake, a child shouting, panicked breathing, wood cracking, a final VHS tracking screech into silence.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Dance Video Prompt with Audio Sync
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a realistic dance short video using Grok Imagine. It specifies character consistency, clothing, accessories, and precise choreography synced to an uploaded audio file. The prompt includes technical parameters like duration (11.2s), aspect ratio (9:16), and camera behavior (static shot).
entries.prompt:
真人实拍舞蹈短视频。人物全程使用预设角色#1的脸部、发型、身材和身份特征，角色#1为成年人。全程只穿预设服装，保持精致五官，佩戴装饰眼镜，脚穿深紫色高跟鞋。人物身份、发型、身材、服装与全部配件全程一致。

总长11.20秒，9:16竖屏，30fps，一镜到底。人物居中，身体正对镜头，动作轻快、俏皮，笑容自然。严格执行以下舞蹈顺序，不增加新动作，不延长准备和定点时间。

【音频锁定】
直接使用上传文件“lumiraexo_on_Reels_audio only.mp4”作为全片唯一配音及背景音轨，从00:00同步起播。保留音频原有的人声、音乐、节奏、音色、速度与停顿，不重新配音，不变调，不另加音乐或台词。音轨在约11.17秒结束，剩余约0.03秒自然留空。
身体换向、手掌推出、抬膝和手势展开跟随这份音频的实际节拍；不要另设与音轨冲突的BPM。人物保持自然微笑和呼吸，不擅自添加明显说话口型。

【逐段动作、表情和目光】
00:00—00:01.10｜交替推掌：
人物双腿自然分开，膝盖放松，髋部随节拍左右换重心。左手放在左耳后，左肘向外打开；右臂向镜头伸出，五指自然展开，掌心朝前，形成清楚的“停一下”手势。随后右手收向右耳侧，左掌接替向前推出，再收回。双手换位顺畅，手掌不触碰镜头。
表情：开场即带明亮自然的微笑。
目光：始终直视镜头。
落点：左右掌分别在节拍上推到最前方，髋部同时换向。

00:01.10—00:02.20｜双手耳后律动：
承接推掌，两手一起收至耳后和后脑两侧，双肘自然向外展开。上身保持舒展，肩部轻微回弹，髋部连续左右摆动。头部先轻轻侧倾，再回正，发丝随肩部运动自然摆动。
表情：笑容略收，转为俏皮、专注的浅笑。
目光：先看镜头，接近段末时短暂向下看。

00:02.20—00:03.40｜单侧抬膝：
右手留在右耳后，左手从头侧沿身体外侧下降，停在左侧大腿前方。重心稳定落在右腿，左膝向前上方抬起，再向左侧略微打开，左手顺势悬停于抬起的大腿上方；随后左腿沿原路径放回地面。只完成一次连续抬膝，不连续踢腿，不拉扯服装。上身仅轻微倾斜以平衡重心。
表情：轻抿嘴，带一点故作认真的俏皮感。
目光：抬膝时看向左腿，落脚时重新看向镜头。
落点：抬膝最高处踩拍，落脚立即衔接下一手势。

00:03.40—00:04.40｜胸前指尖框形：
左脚站稳，两只手同时收回胸前，掌心斜朝镜头；拇指与食指靠近，短暂组成小三角框形。随后双手从中央向两侧展开，并沿弧线下降至腰侧。身体保持轻微左右律动。
表情：从克制浅笑转为明亮笑容。
目光：先看中央指尖，手势展开时抬眼直视镜头。
落点：指尖框形合拢与双手打开分别对应连续节拍。

00:04.40—00:07.20｜低位双手、连续摆胯：
双肘微弯，双手放松握成小拳，停在身体两侧、略低于腰部，拳心自然朝前内侧。保持双手低位，依靠膝盖轻微屈伸完成连续左右换重心，髋部短促推出后经过中心再换向；肩部小幅反向平衡，前臂随节奏自然弹动。双脚基本留在原地。
表情：保持轻松、明亮的笑容，脸颊自然抬起。
目光：大部分时间直视镜头，偶尔随歪头短暂偏移，再立即回看。
落点：每次髋部外推清楚踩拍，不慢放、不拖拍。

00:07.20—00:09.20｜保持律动、短暂收笑：
延续低位双手和左右摆胯，动作幅度与前段一致。头部轻轻向一侧倾，再回正；肩部跟随节拍产生细小回弹，身体不前后大幅移动。
表情：笑容自然收敛，嘴唇轻轻闭合，形成短暂平静神态；随后嘴角再次上扬。
目光：短暂侧看，再回到镜头，保持互动感。

00:09.20—00:11.20｜笑容回归、自然结束：
继续原有左右重心切换，双手仍停在身体两侧，手腕保持放松。头部随节拍轻巧侧倾，最后回到正面，髋部动作自然减小。
表情：重新露出明亮笑容，结束时保持轻松、开心的状态。
目光：直视镜头。
落点：跟随音轨最后的节奏自然收住，不突然僵硬定格。

【镜头与场景】
固定手机正面机位，镜头约在人物胸口高度，略微向上。竖屏中全景，从头顶上方拍至大腿中下部，保留手掌向前推出和左膝抬起的空间。人物前伸手掌时产生自然近大远小透视；摄影机保持原位，不主动推进、不变焦、不环绕、不切镜。
场景为简洁现代室内：人物身后是两扇深色木门，配银色门把手和上方闭门器；周围为浅色墙面和白色天花，顶上可见小型圆形设施。保留真实住宅或酒店房间的日常感。
柔和室内环境光照亮脸部和身体，背景曝光稳定。画面具有真实手机拍摄质感，保留皮肤纹理、发丝和衣料自然惯性，不加入额外灯光特效。
排除：换脸、身份漂移、发型改变、服装变化、丝袜或眼镜消失、高跟鞋改变；多手多指、手指粘连、手掌穿脸、关节反折、抬膝失衡、脚底滑动、双腿乱蹬；动作瞬移、机械摆胯、节奏错位、笑容固定不变、目光漂移、异常说话口型；音频变速、音轨错位、额外配音、额外音乐；推拉运镜、数字变焦、切镜、背景变形、严重拖影、字幕、水印、logo。
entries.translated_prompt:
Realistic live-action dance short video. The character uses the face, hairstyle, body type, and identity features of preset Character #1 throughout. Character #1 is an adult. Wears only the preset outfit throughout, maintaining delicate facial features, wearing decorative glasses, and deep purple high heels. Identity, hairstyle, body, outfit, and all accessories remain consistent.

Total length 11.20 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, 30fps, single continuous shot. Character centered, facing the camera directly, movements light, playful, natural smile. Strictly execute the following dance sequence without adding new moves or extending preparation/hold times.

[Audio Lock]
Use the uploaded file "lumiraexo_on_Reels_audio only.mp4" as the sole voiceover and background track, starting synchronously at 00:00. Retain original vocals, music, rhythm, tone, speed, and pauses; no re-voicing, pitch shifting, or added music/dialogue. Track ends at ~11.17s, leaving ~0.03s natural silence.
Body turns, palm pushes, knee lifts, and hand gestures follow the actual beat of this audio; do not set a conflicting BPM. Maintain natural smile and breathing; do not add obvious lip-sync speech.

[Segment-by-Segment Action, Expression, Gaze]
00:00–00:01.10 | Alternating Palm Push:
Legs naturally apart, knees relaxed, hips shifting weight left/right on beat. Left hand behind left ear, left elbow open outward; right arm extends toward camera, fingers spread, palm forward, forming a clear "stop" gesture. Then right hand returns to right ear side, left palm pushes forward, then retracts. Smooth hand exchange, palms do not touch lens.
Expression: Bright natural smile from start.
Gaze: Always direct eye contact with camera.
Landing: Each palm push reaches max forward on beat, hips shift simultaneously.

00:01.10–00:02.20 | Hands Behind Ears Rhythm:
Following palm push, both hands move behind ears and back-of-head sides, elbows open naturally. Torso relaxed, shoulders slightly rebounding, hips continuously swinging left/right. Head tilts gently then straightens, hair sways naturally with shoulder movement.
Expression: Smile softens to playful, focused slight smile.
Gaze: Looks at camera first, briefly looks down near end of segment.

00:02.20–00:03.40 | Single Knee Lift:
Right hand stays behind right ear, left hand descends along outer body side, stops in front of left thigh. Weight stable on right leg, left knee lifts forward/upward, opens slightly left, left hand hovers above lifted thigh; then left leg returns to ground along same path. Complete one continuous knee lift only, no kicking, no pulling clothes. Torso tilts slightly for balance.
Expression: Light lip press, playful seriousness.
Gaze: Looks at left leg during lift, back to camera upon landing.
Landing: Highest knee point hits beat, landing immediately transitions to next gesture.

00:03.40–00:04.40 | Chest Fingertip Frame:
Left foot planted, both hands return to chest, palms angled toward camera; thumb and index finger approach, briefly forming small triangle frame. Then hands expand from center to sides, descend in arc to waist. Body maintains slight left/right rhythm.
Expression: From restrained smile to bright smile.
Gaze: Looks at central fingertips, raises eyes to direct camera view as hands open.
Landing: Fingertip closure and hand opening correspond to consecutive beats.

00:04.40–00:07.20 | Low Hands, Continuous Hip Swing:
Elbows slightly bent, hands relaxed into small fists, positioned at body sides, slightly below waist, knuckles facing front-inside. Keep hands low, rely on slight knee flexion/extension for continuous left/right weight shifts, hips thrust shortly through center then switch; shoulders counterbalance slightly, forearms bounce naturally with rhythm. Feet stay mostly in place.
Expression: Relaxed, bright smile, cheeks naturally raised.
Gaze: Mostly direct camera, occasionally offset with head tilt, immediately returning.
Landing: Each hip thrust clearly hits beat, no slow motion, no dragging.

00:07.20–00:09.20 | Maintain Rhythm, Brief Smile Reduction:
Continue low hands and left/right hip swing, amplitude consistent with previous segment. Head tilts gently to one side then straightens; shoulders produce fine rebounds with beat, body does not move significantly forward/backward.
Expression: Smile naturally recedes, lips close lightly, forming brief calm state; then corners of mouth rise again.
Gaze: Briefly looks aside, returns to camera, maintaining interaction.

00:09.20–00:11.20 | Smile Return, Natural End:
Continue original left/right weight shifts, hands remain at body sides, wrists relaxed. Head tilts lightly with beat, finally returning to front, hip movements naturally reduce.
Expression: Reveals bright smile again, ending in relaxed, happy state.
Gaze: Direct camera.
Landing: Follows final rhythm of track to settle naturally, no sudden stiff freeze.

[Camera & Scene]
Fixed phone front position, lens approx. chest height, slightly upward. Vertical medium-full shot, capturing from above head to mid-lower thighs, preserving space for palm push and knee lift. Natural perspective enlargement when reaching forward; camera stays static, no zoom, pan, rotate, or cut.
Scene is simple modern interior: Two dark wooden doors behind character with silver handles and closers; surrounding light walls and white ceiling, small circular fixtures visible overhead. Retain everyday feel of real residence or hotel room.
Soft indoor ambient lighting illuminates face and body, stable background exposure. Image has authentic smartphone shooting texture, retaining skin texture, hair strands, and fabric inertia, no extra light effects.
Exclude: Face swap, identity drift, hairstyle change, outfit variation, disappearance of stockings/glasses, heel changes; multiple hands/fingers, fused fingers, palm-through-face, joint hyperextension, knee-lift imbalance, foot sliding, chaotic leg kicks; action teleportation, mechanical hip swings, rhythm misalignment, fixed unchanging smiles, gaze drift, abnormal lip-sync; audio speed changes, track misalignment, extra voiceovers/music; push/pull camera moves, digital zoom, cuts, background deformation, severe blur, subtitles, watermarks, logos.

entries.title: Miniature World Inside Outlet Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Google Flow and Grok Imagine to generate a seamless 10-second video revealing a miniature character's room inside an electrical outlet.
entries.prompt:
【基本設定】
添付の参照画像およびSNSプロフィールを徹底分析し、「そのキャラクターが実際に暮らしていそうな小さな部屋」を完全オリジナルで設計し、動画生成せよ。
・アスペクト比：9:16（縦型）
・尺：約10秒（カット割りや瞬間移動のない、連続したシームレスなワンカット映像）
・スタイル：Photorealistic macro cinematography combined with handcrafted miniature diorama aesthetics.

【プロフィールの分析と内装への変換ルール】（※AIへの設計指示）
参照資料から以下の要素を抽出し、部屋の内装デザインへ直接反映すること。
1. 色彩設計（カラーパレット）：
キャラクターの髪色、瞳、衣装のメインカラーとサブカラー、プロフィール画像のトーンを抽出し、壁紙、ラグ、カーテン、寝具、照明の色合いに反映する。
2. 建築・インテリア様式：
キャラクターの雰囲気や衣装のテイスト（モダン、レトロ、ファンタジー、和風、サイバー、ナチュラル、ゴシック等）を、家具の形状や壁・床の材質に落とし込む。
3. 象徴的アイテム（3〜5個に厳選）：
プロフィール文の記載内容（職業、趣味、好きなもの、特技、世界観）や持ち物から、人格を象徴するアイテムを3〜5個だけ選び、部屋の中で視覚的に目立つ位置へ配置する。（※小物を詰め込みすぎず、生活空間に趣味が自然に滲み出るバランスにする）

【10秒の映像構成（連続したワンカット）】
■ 0〜2秒（導入）：
現実の室内。壁のコンセントカバーを人間の手が丁寧に外す。プラスチックや壁紙、指先の質感までリアルな実写マクロ撮影。カバーの奥から、部屋のテーマカラーを帯びた小さな暖かな光が漏れる。
■ 2〜4秒（侵入）：
カメラが開口部へゆっくり近づき内部を覗き込む。奥行きのある小さな住居空間が徐々に現れ、カメラはスケールダウンしながら自然にミニチュア世界へ侵入する。
■ 4〜8秒（日常）：
カメラが完全に部屋の中へ入る。住人である参照キャラクターが、プロフィールから推論される「最も似合う1つの生活動作（制作、読書、料理、楽器演奏、植物の世話、片付け等）」をして暮らしている。過剰なポーズはとらず、偶然覗いてしまったような自然な生活感を重視。
■ 8〜10秒（余韻）：
キャラクターがカメラに気づいて一瞬こちらを見つめ、小さく愛嬌のある反応をする。温かな部屋の雰囲気と小さな動きを残し、もう一度覗きたくなる余韻で終える。

【キャラクターとクラフト素材感】
・参照元のアイデンティティ（顔立ち、髪型、髪色、目、衣装、装飾品）を厳密に維持し、部屋のスケールに統一する。人物はミニチュアの住人、動物やマスコットは無理に人間化せず元の姿のまま自然に動かす。
・ミニチュア世界は精巧な手作り工芸品の質感。木や粘土の家具、布や毛糸のファブリック、透明レジンの小瓶、ドライフラワーなど適材適所のクラフト素材を組み合わせ、繊維や編み目、手仕事の温もりを感じさせる。
・浅い被写界深度、マクロレンズの自然なボケ、暖色の柔らかな室内光で表現する。

【音声・BGM】
・声：高めで可愛らしい子供のような小さな声。既存言語ではなく、感情が伝わる短い架空の言葉を控えめに話す。
・BGM：部屋の雰囲気に合わせた優しく温かなオルゴール調のインストゥルメンタル。小さな足音や布の擦れる音などの微かな生活音を自然に混ぜる。

【禁止事項】
現実サイズの家具の混在、通常の配線描写、小物の詰め込みすぎ、キャラの改変・別人化、不要な人物や動物の追加、字幕・文字・ロゴ・透かしの表示、過剰な魔法エフェクト、不自然なカット切り替え、派手なBGM。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Basic Settings]
Thoroughly analyze the attached reference image and SNS profile, design a 'small room where the character would actually live' completely originally, and generate a video.
- Aspect Ratio: 9:16 (Vertical)
- Duration: Approx. 10 seconds (Continuous seamless one-cut video without cuts or teleportation)
- Style: Photorealistic macro cinematography combined with handcrafted miniature diorama aesthetics.

[Profile Analysis and Interior Conversion Rules] (*Design instructions for AI*)
Extract the following elements from the reference materials and reflect them directly in the room's interior design.
1. Color Design (Color Palette):
Extract the character's hair color, eye color, main and sub colors of their costume, and the tone of the profile picture, and reflect them in the shades of wallpaper, rugs, curtains, bedding, and lighting.
2. Architectural/Interior Style:
Translate the character's atmosphere and costume taste (Modern, Retro, Fantasy, Japanese, Cyber, Natural, Gothic, etc.) into furniture shapes and wall/floor materials.
3. Symbolic Items (Select 3-5):
From the profile text content (occupation, hobbies, likes, skills, worldview) and belongings, select only 3-5 items that symbolize the personality and place them in visually prominent positions within the room. (*Avoid stuffing too many small objects; maintain a balance where hobbies naturally seep into the living space.*)

[10-Second Video Composition (Continuous One Cut)]
■ 0-2 Seconds (Introduction):
Real indoor setting. A human hand carefully removes the wall outlet cover. Realistic live-action macro photography capturing textures of plastic, wallpaper, and fingertips. From behind the cover, a small warm light tinged with the room's theme color leaks out.
■ 2-4 Seconds (Intrusion):
The camera slowly approaches the opening and peers inside. A deep small residential space gradually appears, and the camera scales down while naturally intruding into the miniature world.
■ 4-8 Seconds (Daily Life):
The camera fully enters the room. The resident reference character is living doing 'the single most fitting daily action inferred from the profile (creation, reading, cooking, playing instruments, plant care, tidying, etc.)'. Avoid excessive posing; emphasize natural daily life as if accidentally peeked upon.
■ 8-10 Seconds (Afterglow):
The character notices the camera, looks at it briefly, and gives a small, charming reaction. End with a lingering feeling that makes you want to peek again, leaving the warm room atmosphere and small movements.

[Character and Craft Material Feel]
- Strictly maintain the original identity (facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, costume, accessories) and unify with the room scale. Characters are miniature residents; animals/mascots are not forcibly anthropomorphized but move naturally in their original form.
- The miniature world has the texture of exquisite handmade crafts. Combine craft materials appropriate for each item, such as wood/clay furniture, fabric/yarn textiles, transparent resin bottles, dried flowers, etc., evoking fibers, knits, and the warmth of handiwork.
- Express with shallow depth of field, natural bokeh from macro lenses, and soft warm indoor lighting.

[Audio/BGM]
- Voice: High-pitched, cute child-like small voice. Speak modestly in short fictional words that convey emotion rather than existing languages.
- BGM: Gentle, warm music-box-style instrumental matching the room's atmosphere. Naturally mix faint daily sounds like small footsteps and rustling cloth.

[Prohibited Items]
Mixing real-sized furniture, normal wiring depiction, overstuffing small objects, character alteration/dehumanization, adding unnecessary people/animals, displaying subtitles/text/logos/watermarks, excessive magic effects, unnatural cut changes, flashy BGM.

entries.prompt:
Subject & Characters: A 1990s Hong Kong action-comedy scene featuring two characters:
An intense male assassin dressed in a retro white suit jacket, black-and-white striped undershirt, black tie, and fingerless gloves, holding a black pistol equipped with a detachable suppressor/silencer.
A surprised young Asian woman with a short black bob haircut, wearing a bright yellow sleeveless top.
Setting & Environment: A bright, minimalist interior space featuring a bathroom and living area separated by a yellow revolving wall panel door. Clean tile walls, high contrast lighting, and a vibrant yellow color scheme.
Action & Motion Sequence:
00:00 – 00:11: Dynamic intercut shots alternating between the assassin dramatically aiming his suppressed handgun and the woman sitting casually on a toilet in the adjoining bathroom area.
00:12 – 00:25: The assassin lowers his weapon slightly and pushes against the central yellow revolving partition wall, causing it to swivel open.
00:26 – 00:38: In a comedic slapstick timing, as the yellow partition spins around, the woman stands up and walks around the rotating door into the adjacent room, while the assassin swivels into the space she just vacated—causing them to narrowly miss seeing each other.
00:39 – 00:40: The woman enters the bathroom stall from the other side and sits back down, right as the assassin turns around and points his gun through the open partition directly back at her.
Cinematography & Visual Style:
Style: 1990s Hong Kong retro action-comedy film, cinematic film grain, saturated yellow and white color palette, sharp medium shots.
Camera Movement: Fast cuts, eye-level framing, steady horizontal panning following the rotation of the revolving wall.

entries.title: Dinosaur Encounter Cinematic Sequence
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video prompt featuring a woman encountering a T-rex-like predator, including specific timing, camera moves, audio cues, and negative prompts.
entries.prompt:
0-3s: Close-up of her peering over the log, breathing shallowly. Behind her, out of focus, a dark horned dinosaur silhouette emerges from the mist.
3-8s: Slow push-in as a huge, dark-scaled T-rex-like predator stalks toward her, claws pressing into the mud. Steam blasts from its nostrils and drifts through the fog. Her expression shifts from fear to panic.
8-11s: Extreme close-up of her face: wide, tearful eyes, trembling lips, a single tear rolling down her muddy cheek, quick shallow breaths.
11-13s: Soft dissolve to a over-the-shoulder shot from behind her, the dinosaur's head looming close.
13-15s: The dinosaur freezes inches away, then opens its jaws wide, showing rows of teeth, and lets out a deafening roar as the shot holds.
Audio: Rain dripping, distant jungle ambience, heavy footsteps with low rumbles, her ragged breathing, and a loud roar at the end.
Negative prompt: cartoon look, extra limbs, distorted face, text, watermark, blur, low resolution.

entries.title: Sydney Sweeney Underwater Neon Adventure
entries.description: A complex, multi-second video prompt featuring Sydney Sweeney in an underwater neon nightclub sequence with specific pacing, transitions, and visual styles.
entries.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic video, 10 seconds, starring Sydney Sweeney as the main character, with her recognizable facial features, wavy blonde hair, and expressive smile. Ultra-fast pacing, whip-pan transitions, and beat-synced cuts approximately every second.

0–2 seconds: Sydney Sweeney, wearing a sleek black freediving wetsuit with a small action camera attached to her chest strap, swims rapidly through crystal-clear turquoise water above white sand. Sunbeams ripple across her face as the camera tracks her with dynamic underwater movement.

2–4 seconds: She speeds past vibrant coral reefs toward a shimmering curtain of iridescent beads. A dramatic speed ramp follows as she bursts through the sparkling curtain. The camera whip-pans into a mysterious dark coral cave, where violet light illuminates the surrounding water.

4–6 seconds: Explosive reveal of a futuristic underwater nightclub filled with neon lasers, colorful strobes, floating luminous star-shaped sunglasses, and tropical fish moving rhythmically to the music. Sydney emerges through a glowing violet portal as cyan, magenta, and purple lights illuminate her face.

6–10 seconds: Sydney puts on oversized neon star-shaped sunglasses, spins playfully in zero gravity underwater, and laughs as glowing bubbles and particles swirl around her. The camera circles her rapidly with energetic zooms, sharp whip-pans, and smooth speed-ramp transitions, ending on a dramatic close-up of her smiling face against the vibrant nightclub.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic cinematic footage, lifelike facial details, consistent character appearance, realistic underwater physics, volumetric lighting, vivid turquoise water, neon magenta and cyan highlights, violet glow, floating particles, smooth motion blur, high contrast, premium music-video aesthetics, 24 fps.

Audio: Energetic electronic dance music, deep underwater whooshes, sparkling sound effects, and a bass drop during the nightclub reveal.

Continuity: Keep Sydney Sweeney recognizable and visually consistent throughout all shots. No face distortion, duplicate characters, flickering facial features, unwanted text, logos, or watermarks.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Video Prompt: Realistic Gym Horror Transformation
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Grok Imagine that creates a realistic, found-footage style horror scene. It features a man in a gym with abnormal muscle growth and embedded metal plates, emphasizing continuity, camera movement, and specific visual constraints to avoid typical AI artifacts.
entries.prompt:
[参考锁定]

使用新生成的首帧@1作为外形与环境参考。

男性为38岁左右成年人，寸头、短胡茬，赤裸上身，深灰色橙边运动短裤、灰黑运动鞋。

肩背已有异常肌肉肿块，开场就存在，不在视频里重新长出来。

左肩胛至肋部是一块纵向、不对称的巨大隆起；右肩有较小的叠层肌肉鼓包。

左侧肿块表面两道暗紫色裂隙状创口，边缘皱缩、不规则。

肿块有真实重量，随肌肉收缩轻微挤压，不能像气球一样充气。

无喷血、组织爆裂或额外肢体。

[风格与镜头]

9:16竖屏，12秒连续手机录像。

摄影者站在男子左后方约两米，胸口高度拍摄。

开场以三分之二背面角度呈现，肩背肿块、手臂和曲杆杠铃同时可见。

轻微手抖、小幅构图调整，不环绕、不切镜、不慢动作。

普通旧健身房记录：平淡荧光灯、轻微噪点、压缩痕迹、汗水反光和自然运动模糊。

没有恐怖电影灯光，没有背景音乐。

[环境与道具]

旧社区地下健身房，白色立柱、浅绿墙裙、磨损灰色地面、红色训练凳、哑铃架和墙上风扇。

背景一名灰衣成年健身者继续训练，不围观、不尖叫。

主角双手握同一根曲杆杠铃，两侧黑色杠铃片数量固定。

[0—4秒｜认真完成弯举]

男子双脚站稳，双肘靠近身体，将杠铃从髋部抬向胸前。

前臂先弯曲，肱二头肌随后收紧。

背部巨大隆起随着肩部受力轻微挤压，两道创口位置保持不变。

他低头看杠铃，表情吃力，短促呼气。

手机轻微调整，保持异常肩背和弯举动作同框。

[4—7秒｜缓慢放下]

男子控制杠铃下降，直到双臂接近伸直。

肩背软组织随卸力稍微下沉、晃动，然后稳定。

汗水沿皮肤流下。

不能突然缩回正常身材，不能新增肿块。

[7—10秒｜结束训练]

他屈膝、向前俯身，把杠铃放到脚前地面。

杠铃片先接触地面，再松开双手。

传来一次沉闷金属碰响。

手机自然向下跟一点，随后抬回上身。

男子直起身体，粗重呼吸。

[10—12秒｜发现有人拍他]

男子先转头看镜头，再转动肩膀和躯干，变成偏正面的站姿。

双臂自然垂下，肩背异常体积仍能从轮廓辨认。

他看着拍摄者喘气，嘴微张，没有扑向镜头。

画面直接结束。

[现场声音]

呼吸、鞋底摩擦、杠铃片轻响、器械碰撞和墙上风扇。

无配乐、旁白、字幕或怪物吼叫。

[连续性约束]

只有一个主角、两条手臂、一根杠铃。

异常肌肉和创口保持固定位置，不逐帧换形。

握杠、弯举、下降、落地、松手的顺序完整。

镜头留在同一观察位置，由男子转身呈现正面。

不加入袭击、触须、突然变身或血腥爆裂。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Reference Lock]

Use the newly generated first frame @1 as the reference for appearance and environment.

The male is an adult around 38 years old, with a buzz cut, short stubble, shirtless, wearing dark grey sports shorts with orange trim, and grey-black sneakers.

Abnormal muscle lumps already exist on his shoulders and back at the start; they do not grow during the video.

From the left scapula to the ribs is a vertical, asymmetric massive bulge; the right shoulder has smaller stacked muscle bumps.

On the surface of the left lump are two dark purple fissure-like wounds, with shriveled, irregular edges.

The lump has real weight, slightly compressing with muscle contraction, not inflating like a balloon.

No blood spraying, tissue bursting, or extra limbs.

[Style and Camera]

9:16 portrait, 12-second continuous mobile phone recording.

The cameraman stands about two meters behind and to the left of the man, shooting from chest height.

Opens with a two-thirds rear angle showing the shoulder/back lump, arms, and EZ curl bar simultaneously.

Slight hand shake, minor composition adjustments, no circling, no cuts, no slow motion.

Ordinary old gym record: flat fluorescent lights, slight noise, compression artifacts, sweat reflections, and natural motion blur.

No horror movie lighting, no background music.

[Environment and Props]

Old community basement gym, white pillars, light green wall wainscoting, worn grey floor, red training bench, dumbbell rack, and wall fan.

An adult fitness enthusiast in grey clothes continues training in the background, not watching or screaming.

The protagonist holds the same EZ curl bar with both hands, with a fixed number of black weight plates on each side.

[0-4s | Completing Bicep Curls Seriously]

The man stands firm, elbows close to body, lifting the bar from hips to chest.

Forearms bend first, then biceps tighten.

The massive back bulge slightly compresses with shoulder force, wound positions remain unchanged.

He looks down at the bar, expression strained, short exhale.

Phone adjusts slightly, keeping abnormal shoulders/back and curl action in frame.

[4-7s | Slowly Lowering]

The man controls the bar descent until arms are nearly straight.

Shoulder/back soft tissues sink and sway slightly with unloading, then stabilize.

Sweat flows down skin.

Cannot suddenly shrink back to normal physique, cannot add new lumps.

[7-10s | Ending Training]

He bends knees, leans forward, places the bar on the ground before his feet.

Weight plates touch ground first, then he releases hands.

A dull metallic clank is heard.

Phone naturally follows down slightly, then lifts back to upper body.

Man straightens up, breathing heavily.

[10-12s | Notices Being Filmed]

The man turns head to look at camera first, then rotates shoulders and torso into a more frontal stance.

Arms hang naturally, abnormal shoulder/back volume still discernible from silhouette.

He pants looking at the filmer, mouth slightly open, does not lunge at camera.

Scene ends directly.

[Live Sound]

Breathing, shoe friction, light clinking of weight plates, equipment collision, and wall fan.

No soundtrack, narration, subtitles, or monster roars.

[Continuity Constraints]

Only one protagonist, two arms, one barbell.

Abnormal muscles and wounds maintain fixed positions, no per-frame morphing.

Sequence of gripping, curling, lowering, landing, releasing is complete.

Camera stays at the same observation position, front view presented by man turning.

No attacks, tentacles, sudden transformations, or bloody bursts.

entries.title: Restaurant Meme Video: Shoe-Sole Dried Tofu
entries.description: A prompt for creating a humorous 10-second vertical video in a restaurant where a customer picks up dried tofu that looks like a shoe sole, interacting with a waiter.
entries.prompt:
【整体设定】

10秒，9:16竖屏，真实手机餐馆随手拍，一镜到底。

上传的重绘图片作为尾帧参考，锁定鞋底状豆腐干的形状、夹持位置、餐桌布局、服务员外貌与最终构图。

【场景与拍摄关系】

普通中式小餐馆，暖色吊灯、米色餐桌，背景有自然吃饭聊天的顾客。

前景是装着红油、豆腐干、面条与蔬菜的白色大碗，旁边有汤碗、茶壶和纸巾盒。

坐着的成年男子用左手持手机拍摄，用右手持两根木筷夹菜。只有夹菜的手进入画面，男子的脸与身体始终在画外。

服务员穿黑色上衣和酒红色围裙，位于桌对面的画面右侧。

手机轻微手持晃动，自然室内曝光，普通手机压缩质感，无美颜、无电影调色。

【关键道具】

只有一片鞋底状豆腐干：棕黄色、薄片、表面挂着红油和葱花，有清晰方格压纹，轮廓与尾帧一致。

它是柔韧的食物，不是真鞋底，不出现鞋面、橡胶或鞋子。

筷子夹住豆腐干上端，两根筷子的接触点准确，夹起后下端自然垂落。

【严格时间分镜】

0—2秒：

镜头略向下对着菜碗。男子的右手从左侧伸入画面，用两根木筷夹住碗内那片豆腐干的上端。

豆腐干此时部分浸在红油里，尚未完整露出轮廓。

2—4.5秒：

男子缓慢向上提起筷子。

整片豆腐干从碗里连续抽出，先露出上端，再露出方格纹路、收窄的中段和圆弧下端，逐渐呈现鞋底般的完整形状。

豆腐干轻轻摆动，两三滴酱汁落回碗中。

镜头随持机手小幅向上抬，使整片豆腐干始终留在画面内。

4.5—6秒：

男子停住筷子，像在仔细看这片食物，低声疑惑地说：

“这豆腐干……”

服务员听见声音，从桌对面稍微靠近，目光先看向筷子，再移到豆腐干。

6—9秒：

男子保持夹持，轻轻将豆腐干朝服务员方向展示，问：

“服务员，怎么长得跟鞋底似的？”

语气自然、困惑，带一点难以置信，不大声斥责。

服务员低头看它，眉头逐渐皱起，嘴唇轻抿，停顿一下，没有立即回答。

豆腐干仍悬在菜碗上方，不触碰服务员。

9—10秒：

镜头停留在完整豆腐干与服务员疑惑的反应上。

筷子、豆腐干、餐具和服务员位置对齐尾帧参考，最后保持至少一秒，留下安静的喜剧停顿。

【声音】

成年男子自然说话声，来自镜头附近。

保留筷子轻碰碗沿、酱汁滴落、邻桌低声聊天与餐具碰撞声。

无旁白、无背景音乐、无夸张喜剧音效。

【连续性与约束】

必须先夹住再提起，豆腐干沿连续轨迹从碗中出现，不瞬移、不复制。

夹起前后保持同一形状、尺寸、方格纹路和颜色。

筷子保持两根，不穿透食物，不变形；手指正常。

服务员只自然靠近并观察，不抢走食物，不提前夸张惊叫。

不切镜、不突然变焦、不慢动作、不添加鞋子或其他解释道具。

生成时不添加文字、水印和平台界面。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overall Setting]

10 seconds, 9:16 vertical, realistic casual smartphone footage in a restaurant, single take.

Uploaded redrawn image serves as end-frame reference, locking the shape of the shoe-sole-shaped dried tofu, gripping position, table layout, waiter's appearance, and final composition.

[Scene & Filming Relationship]

Ordinary small Chinese restaurant, warm pendant lights, beige tables, customers eating and chatting naturally in background.

Foreground features large white bowl containing chili oil, dried tofu, noodles, and vegetables, with soup bowl, teapot, and tissue box nearby.

Seated adult man holds phone with left hand, uses two wooden chopsticks in right hand to pick food. Only picking hand enters frame; man's face and body remain off-screen.

Waiter wears black top and wine-red apron, positioned on right side across the table.

Slight handheld shake, natural indoor exposure, ordinary phone compression quality, no beauty filter, no cinematic color grading.

[Key Prop]

Only one piece of shoe-sole-shaped dried tofu: brownish-yellow, thin slice, surface coated with chili oil and scallions, clear grid pattern, outline consistent with end frame.

It is flexible food, not a real shoe sole, no shoe upper, rubber, or shoes appear.

Chopsticks grip top end of tofu, contact points accurate, bottom end hangs naturally when lifted.

[Strict Time Storyboard]

0–2s:

Camera slightly downward toward dish bowl. Man's right hand enters from left, using two wooden chopsticks to grip top end of tofu piece in bowl.

Tofu partially submerged in chili oil, outline not fully revealed yet.

2–4.5s:

Man slowly lifts chopsticks upward.

Entire tofu piece continuously extracted from bowl, first revealing top end, then grid pattern, narrowed middle section, and rounded bottom, gradually presenting complete shoe-sole shape.

Tofu sways gently, two or three drops of sauce fall back into bowl.

Camera lifts slightly with holding hand, keeping entire tofu piece within frame.

4.5–6s:

Man stops chopsticks, appearing to examine food closely, mutters suspiciously:

"This dried tofu..."

Waiter hears sound, approaches slightly from across table, gaze shifts from chopsticks to tofu.

6–9s:

Man maintains grip, gently displays tofu toward waiter, asks:

"Waiter, why does it look like a shoe sole?"

Tone natural, confused, slightly incredulous, not shouting accusations.

Waiter looks down at it, eyebrows gradually furrow, lips purse lightly, pauses, does not answer immediately.

Tofu still suspended above bowl, does not touch waiter.

9–10s:

Camera rests on complete tofu piece and waiter's puzzled reaction.

Chopsticks, tofu, utensils, and waiter positions align with end-frame reference, hold for at least one second, leaving quiet comedic pause.

[Sound]

Adult man's natural speaking voice, originating near camera.

Retain sounds of chopsticks lightly hitting bowl rim, sauce dripping, low-volume chat from neighboring tables, and clinking utensils.

No narration, no background music, no exaggerated comedy sound effects.

[Continuity & Constraints]

Must grip before lifting, tofu emerges along continuous trajectory from bowl, no teleportation, no duplication.

Maintain same shape, size, grid pattern, and color before and after lifting.

Keep two chopsticks, do not pierce food, do not deform; fingers normal.

Waiter only naturally approaches and observes, does not snatch food, does not scream prematurely.

No cuts, no sudden zoom, no slow motion, no adding shoes or other explanatory props.

Generated output must not include text, watermarks, or platform interfaces.

entries.title: Zombie Duo Dance Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 15-second vertical Halloween zombie duo dance video using Grok Imagine. Includes strict constraints on dancer positions, appearance locks to prevent horror makeup, and specific camera zoom instructions synced to the beat.
entries.prompt:
15s Halloween Zombie Duo Dance | 9:16 Vertical | Two Dancers | Fixed Background | Fixed Camera | Beat-Synced Zoom & Close-Up | Horror Trap Hip-Hop

MUSIC / ENERGY:
An intense beat that kicks in suddenly right from the start, 155 BPM horror trap hip-hop. Hard drums, heavy bass, High speed, sharp accents, energetic and dynamic.

ABSOLUTE LOCK:
Exactly two dancers only. Dancer A always stays on the LEFT, Dancer B always stays on the RIGHT. Same faces, bodies, hairstyles, outfits, positions, background, lighting, colors, and shadows throughout. No swapping, no crossing places, no morphing, no extra dancers, no cuts. Background never changes.

Zombie Dance (Top Priority):
Both dancers extend their arms straight out in front at shoulder height, bend their wrists precisely 90 degrees downward, and spread their fingers naturally and straight, unleashing an incredibly fast, aggressive, and high-energy "zombie dance." The performance features a sequence of movements including rapid "zombie steps" with stiff legs, explosive shoulder actions, intense chest pops, sharp head movements, powerful knee lifts, wide-kneed squats, sudden lunges, and vigorous, rhythmic body shaking.

Use DOUBLE-TIME footwork at 155 BPM, rapid acceleration, abrupt freezes, explosive restarts, and hard beat accents.
Include some sections where both dancers perform different dance moves at the same time while keeping the permanent zombie arm pose.

DUO DANCE RULE:
This is a duo dance, but they must not be perfectly synchronized all the time.
They move in the same overall rhythm, but with slight timing offsets, alternating accents, and different body actions.

FINISH:
The two of them strike a zombie pose, and the shot zooms in to a close-up of their eyes glowing red as they stare into the camera.

APPEARANCE LOCK — ABSOLUTE PRIORITY:
Preserve both dancers' original faces, natural skin tones, hairstyles, and makeup exactly as shown in the initial frame. No zombie makeup, horror makeup, corpse makeup, pale or gray skin, darkened eye sockets, facial discoloration, or grotesque facial effects. No blood, fake blood, bleeding, wounds, scars, bruises, or visible injuries. Express the zombie character exclusively through stiff body movements, unnatural head tilts, dragging steps, sharp shoulder hits, and eerie facial expressions. Do not alter either dancer's appearance throughout the video.

CAMERA:
Fixed frontal camera only. No camera movement, no pan, no tilt, no dolly.
Use only fast beat-synced optical zoom-ins, snap zoom-outs, and brief punch-in close-up framing to create speed and impact while keeping the camera position fixed. Keep the same background at all times.

entries.title: Realistic Selfie Video Generation
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 12-second vertical realistic selfie video featuring emotional expressions, specific clothing, and accessories based on reference images.
entries.prompt:
【任务】

生成12秒、9:16竖屏真实手机自拍视频。复刻参考视频《气得肚子疼》的躺床构图、动作顺序、哭笑混杂的表情和节奏，将原人物替换为指定成年女性。

【参考分工与人物锁定】

人物参考图锁定女性面孔 @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba 、五官比例和黑色长发，不继承原视频男性的外貌。

服装和身材比例参考图锁定 @8149c66e-9a91-4b88-bf26-d0a764075ccf ，服装完整穿着。

眼镜参考图锁定银色装饰眼镜 @d80c71c5-d330-4baf-8ecf-8b793ee0fee8 ：细银色金属线、开放式弧形下眼框、透明鼻托、鼻梁附近的小蝴蝶结金属线圈、两侧各一枚垂挂花朵。镜腿正常架在耳朵上，双眼清晰可见。眼镜全程佩戴，不变成普通粗框眼镜，不出现展示架。

原视频仅锁定表演、自拍角度、动作与节奏。

不要继承此前九宫格中的坠落镜头。

【场景与拍摄】

她仰躺在白色床铺上，头枕白色枕头，长发自然散开。

左手在画外举着手机，前置镜头位于脸部上方约40厘米，向下拍摄脸、肩膀与上半身。脸部占据画面主体。

右手可伸到画面下沿按住腹部。

全程一镜到底，镜头仅随持机手、呼吸和肩膀颤动产生轻微晃动。自然卧室光，普通手机原生画质，真实皮肤纹理，无美颜。

【严格时间与表演】

0—2.8秒：

开场便是气急后的哭笑状态。她眉心紧皱，眼睛挤闭，嘴角横向拉开，断续发出“哈哈哈哈……啊……哈哈”。

笑声带委屈和气恼，肩膀轻颤，头在枕头上小幅偏动。

银色花朵垂饰随头部动作轻轻摆动，鼻托和镜腿始终贴合面部。

2.8—5.8秒：

她停下来吸气，勉强睁眼看手机屏幕，眉头仍皱着，嘴角下撇，带着气恼和委屈说：

“家人们，气得我肚子疼。”

说到后半句时，右手按住腹部，头偏向一侧，眼睛再次挤闭。手机随身体颤动轻微晃动，脸部仍清晰可读。

5.8—9.3秒：

她试着缓一口气，却再次发出破碎的“哈哈哈……啊……”

嘴张开、短暂抿住、又张开，呈现想笑又想哭的反应。眉心挤紧，鼻翼轻动，下巴轻颤，偶尔露齿。

头从侧偏位置回到枕头中央，右手继续按腹部。眼镜随头移动，花朵垂饰自然摆动。

9.3—12秒：

她短暂睁眼看向屏幕，气恼地说：

“气死我了。”

说完闭眼皱鼻，再露出哭笑混杂的表情，以一声短促苦笑和呼气结束。

始终躺在原位，不起身，不增加其他剧情。

【音频】

自然成年女性声线，手机近距离收音，嘴型与台词同步。

笑声断续、有吸气和气音，情绪是气恼、委屈与苦笑交织。

轻微枕头摩擦、衣料摩擦与室内底噪，无旁白、无背景音乐。

若生成工具支持参考视频音频，优先匹配原片的停顿、笑声与说话节奏。

【关键要求】

保留原片夸张的挤眼、皱眉、张嘴和头部摆动，不能变成漂亮微笑或平静口播。

表情挤压五官时仍保持同一人物身份。

眼镜结构、花朵数量、服装、发型、床铺与光线全程一致。

不换脸，不让眼镜悬浮或穿过皮肤，不增加花朵挂件，不出现额外手臂或异常手指。

不切镜，不坠落，不翻滚机位，不慢动作，不电影运镜。

生成画面不添加字幕、截图贴纸、水印或平台界面。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Task]

Generate a 12-second, 9:16 vertical realistic smartphone selfie video. Replicate the lying-on-bed composition, action sequence, mixed crying-and-laughing expressions, and rhythm from the reference video 'Angry Until Stomach Hurts', replacing the original character with a specified adult female.

[Reference Division and Character Locking]

Lock the face to the female portrait in reference image @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba, including facial proportions and long black hair; do not inherit the male appearance from the original video.

Lock clothing and body proportions to reference image @8149c66e-9a91-4b88-bf26-d0a764075ccf, ensuring clothes are fully worn.

Lock glasses to silver decorative glasses in reference image @d80c71c5-d330-4baf-8ecf-8b793ee0fee8: thin silver metal wireframes, open curved lower rims, transparent nose pads, small bow-tie metal coils near the bridge, and one hanging flower charm on each side. Temples rest normally on ears, eyes clearly visible. Glasses must be worn throughout, not changing into thick-rimmed glasses or display stands.

The original video only locks performance, selfie angle, actions, and rhythm.

Do not inherit the falling shot from the previous nine-grid.

[Scene and Filming]

She lies supine on white bedding, head on a white pillow, long hair naturally spread out.

Left hand holds the phone off-screen; front camera is approx. 40cm above the face, shooting downwards capturing face, shoulders, and upper body. Face occupies the main subject area.

Right hand may reach the bottom edge of the frame to press the abdomen.

One continuous take throughout; camera shakes slightly only due to holding hand, breathing, and shoulder tremors. Natural bedroom lighting, standard smartphone native quality, realistic skin texture, no beauty filters.

[Strict Timing and Performance]

0–2.8s:

Opens immediately in a state of angry crying/laughing. Brows furrowed tightly, eyes squeezed shut, mouth corners pulled horizontally, intermittently emitting "Hahaha... Ah... Haha".

Laughter carries grievance and anger; shoulders tremble lightly, head moves slightly on the pillow.

Silver flower charms sway gently with head movement; nose pads and temples remain fitted to the face.

2.8–5.8s:

She stops to inhale, barely opens eyes to look at the screen, brows still furrowed, mouth corners turned down, speaking with anger and grievance:

"Family, I'm so angry my stomach hurts."

As she says the second half, right hand presses abdomen, head turns to the side, eyes squeeze shut again. Phone shakes slightly with body tremors, face remains clearly readable.

5.8–9.3s:

She tries to catch her breath but emits broken "Hahaha... Ah..."

Mouth opens, briefly purses, then opens again, showing a reaction wanting to laugh yet cry. Brows tighten, nostrils flare slightly, chin trembles, occasionally showing teeth.

Head returns from side position to center of pillow, right hand continues pressing abdomen. Glasses move with head, flower charms sway naturally.

9.3–12s:

Briefly opens eyes looking at screen, angrily saying:

"I'm so angry I could die."

Then closes eyes, scrunches nose, reveals mixed crying/laughing expression, ending with a short bitter laugh and exhale.

Remains lying in place, does not get up, adds no other plot.

[Audio]

Natural adult female voice, close-range phone recording, lip-sync with dialogue.

Intermittent laughter, with inhales and breathy sounds; emotion is a mix of anger, grievance, and bitter laughter.

Slight pillow rustling, fabric friction, and indoor ambient noise; no narration, no background music.

If generation tool supports reference video audio, prioritize matching pauses, laughter, and speech rhythm of the original clip.

[Key Requirements]

Retain exaggerated eye-squeezing, brow-furrowing, mouth-opening, and head-shaking from original; must not become pretty smile or calm talking-head.

Maintain same character identity even when expressions distort features.

Glasses structure, number of flowers, clothing, hairstyle, bed, and lighting consistent throughout.

No face swapping, no floating glasses or clipping through skin, no extra flower charms, no extra arms or abnormal fingers.

No cuts, no falling, no rolling camera angles, no slow motion, no cinematic camera moves.

Do not add subtitles, screenshot stickers, watermarks, or platform UI to generated frames.

entries.title: Grok Imagine E.T. Homage Video Workflow
entries.description: A two-step prompt workflow for Grok Imagine to recreate the iconic flying bicycle scene from the movie E.T. Step 1 generates the cinematic still, and Step 2 animates it.
entries.prompt:
Use the attached photo only as a face/identity reference.
Generate a brand-new cinematic still.

The person is already riding a bicycle through the night sky.
Classic E.T. scene: the bike is flying in silhouette in front of a huge full moon.
Warm 1980s Spielberg look, 16:9, anamorphic, film grain, nostalgic cinematic lighting.

The person is on the bicycle. E.T. is in the front basket.
Night sky, giant moon behind them, quiet suburban houses far below.
Already in the air. Not on the ground. Not a normal photo.

Do not reproduce the original photo composition.
Do not keep the original background.
Do not make a photo-to-scene transition image.
First and only frame = finished movie still.
Keep the same face.
No text, no watermark.

Animate this image.
This image is already the first frame. Do not fade from any other photo.

The bicycle slowly flies across the giant moon.
Pedals move gently. Coat and hair drift in the night wind.
E.T. stays in the basket. The person stays the same person, same face.
Stars twinkle. The moon stays huge behind them.
Slow, magical, floating motion. No sudden drops.

Camera: slow sideways tracking, slight low angle, anamorphic widescreen.
Style: 1982 Spielberg cinematic, warm nostalgic night, film grain.
No cut, no dissolve from a different image, no original-photo flash.

preview_videos.caption: Grok Imagine E.T. Homage Video Workflow

entries.title: Dark Fantasy Warrior Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed multi-scene prompt for a cinematic dark fantasy action sequence involving a white-haired warrior and shadowy enemies.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic vertical 9:16 dark-fantasy action sequence, inspired by high-budget Asian fantasy cinema.

Scene 1 — 0–3s:
A mysterious white-haired warrior stands in a misty ancient mountain forest, surrounded by shallow reflective water. Long white hair moves naturally in the wind, wearing elegant black-and-white fantasy robes. The camera slowly pushes toward the warrior as blue-white energy begins swirling around them.

Scene 2 — 3–7s:
Several shadowy black-armored warriors emerge through the mist and rush forward. The white-haired warrior suddenly moves with supernatural speed, creating a powerful circular wave of glowing blue water and energy. Cinematic slow motion, realistic cloth and hair physics, flying water droplets.

Scene 3 — 7–11s:
Close-up combat. The white-haired warrior blocks an enemy weapon with a glowing energy blade. A bright blue-white shockwave explodes between them, sending water droplets and particles through the air. Dynamic camera orbit, dramatic impact, detailed facial expressions.

Scene 4 — 11–15s:
The warrior releases one final concentrated energy strike. A huge arc of blue-white energy sweeps across the water, knocking the shadow warriors backward. End with the white-haired warrior standing calmly in the mist as glowing particles fall around them.

Visual style: photorealistic cinematic fantasy, ultra-detailed characters, realistic skin and hair, physically accurate water, volumetric fog, dramatic moonlight, deep shadows, blue-white magical energy, realistic particle effects, anamorphic cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera motion, high-budget VFX, epic atmosphere.

No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no cartoon look, no distorted faces, no extra limbs, no blurry characters. Maintain consistent character appearance throughout the entire video.

entries.title: Concert Dance Performance Video

Keep the exact same woman, face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, boots, stage, lighting, camera angle and concert environment from the reference image. Upbeat pop-dance music with a catchy beat, energetic drums, bass and bright synths, perfectly synchronized with her movements. Keep the scene visually consistent from beginning to end, cinematic, high quality, realistic concert performance.

Negative prompt:

No face change, no identity change, no clothes change, no extra fingers, no extra arms or legs, no body distortion, no warped hands, no unnatural movement, no camera glitches, no background changes

entries.title: Grok Imagine Realistic Travel Vlog Prompt
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Grok Imagine creating a realistic selfie-style travel vlog featuring giant mechanical statues and cave giants, with specific timing, camera angles, and dialogue instructions.
entries.prompt:
15秒，9:16竖屏，照片级写实手机旅行vlog，全程由成年女主亲自使用前置镜头自拍。女主身份参考#1 @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba ，服装、鞋袜和饰品严格参考#2 @c6a3d787-bf2f-4ae9-a647-8da9db2702e3 ，不使用场景图中的人物替换女主。场景参考#3 @cf1b1405-e241-46d5-818c-7838463fe334 的云海机械巨像与#4 @7953261f-23e7-4c97-b6a0-14bcf07aabe4 的洞穴巨人。两个地点之间使用明确旅行跳剪，表示中间路程已经省略，不表现成一步跨越空间。

她始终右手持手机，左手用于扶岩、保持平衡。手机在脸前约一臂距离，广角自拍中脸位于画面一侧，环境从肩后展开。人物与环境共享自然光、阴影、尘埃和风，保留真实皮肤纹理。只有符合脚步和手腕动作的抖动、短暂曝光调整与运动模糊。无美颜、无配乐、无字幕。

【0—4秒】

云海上方的宽阔岩台，女主沿远离崖缘的内侧缓慢行走。她侧转身体，让两尊嵌在山体中的金色机械巨像出现在肩后：巨大的胸甲占据背景，腿部消失在云层中，远处几名旅行者显得极小。

夕阳照亮她一侧脸颊，风掀动发梢。她先仰头，再看镜头，带着压不住的惊叹轻声说：

“这景区，保安比山还高。”

【4—7秒】

她停下来继续仰望。其中一尊巨像胸口的橙光缓慢增强，头部发生极小幅度转动；片刻后，低沉机械声传到岩台。

她先听声，再抬眼确认，原本的笑容逐渐收住。左手下意识扶住身旁岩壁，手机稍微收近。她不再说话，只短促吸气。

背景旅行者各自停步观察，没有整齐划一地转头。

【7—11秒】

明确硬切，省略转场路程：她已经来到参考#4的洞穴外侧碎石通道。

光线变为洞口反射的灰白日光，身后有羊群、木栅栏和散落的篮筐。她原本沿通道行走，一名惊慌的古代士兵从她左侧跑过，紧接着又有两人绕过碎石奔逃。

她先侧身让路，疑惑地追看他们；随后沉重脚步响起，地面细石跳动。她回头看向洞口，身体随之侧转，使巨人的脸从肩后岩壁之间显露出来。

她压低声音说：

“等等……他们不是来排队的。”

【11—15秒】

巨人俯身挤向洞口，肩膀蹭落碎石，扬起的灰尘遮住部分木栅栏。女主立刻停止说话。

她先看清前方退路，再跟着逃离人群沿通道快步离开，右手将手机收近，左臂抬起护住额侧。自拍画面随脚步颠簸，巨人只在肩后短暂出现，不追求完整全身构图。

最后两秒，她侧身进入右侧岩壁凹处，屈膝降低身体，左手撑住岩面。结束画面：她背靠岩壁，右手手机位于胸口略向上，脸上有薄薄浮尘，嘴唇微张、呼吸急促；画面左缘仍能看到洞口方向飘来的灰尘。

声音：高处风声、低频机械声；跳剪后换成羊叫、奔跑脚步、碎石滚动、巨人呼吸和她近距离的喘息。只有女主说出清晰台词，背景人物喊声含混。

禁止第三人称跟拍、航拍、悬空手机、奔跑时持续直视镜头、凭空换装、无视危险微笑讲解。巨人不瞬移到她面前。
entries.translated_prompt:
15 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, photorealistic mobile phone travel vlog, entirely self-shot by an adult female protagonist using the front camera. The protagonist's identity refers to #1 @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba, clothing, shoes, socks, and accessories strictly refer to #2 @c6a3d787-bf2f-4ae9-a647-8da9db2702e3, do not replace the protagonist with characters from scene images. Scene references include the sea of clouds mechanical colossus in #3 @cf1b1405-e241-46d5-818c-7838463fe334 and the cave giant in #4 @7953261f-23e7-4c97-b6a0-14bcf07aabe4. Use explicit travel jump cuts between the two locations to indicate that the journey in between has been omitted, rather than showing a single step crossing space.

She always holds the phone in her right hand, while her left hand is used to steady herself on rocks or maintain balance. The phone is about one arm's length from her face; in the wide-angle selfie, her face is positioned on one side of the frame, with the environment unfolding behind her shoulder. The character and environment share natural light, shadows, dust, and wind, preserving realistic skin texture. Only include shaking consistent with foot and wrist movements, brief exposure adjustments, and motion blur. No beauty filters, no background music, no subtitles.

[0-4 seconds]

On a broad rock platform above the sea of clouds, the female protagonist slowly walks along the inner side away from the cliff edge. She turns her body sideways so that two golden mechanical colossi embedded in the mountain appear behind her shoulder: huge breastplates occupy the background, legs disappearing into the clouds, with distant travelers appearing extremely small.

Sunset illuminates one side of her cheek, wind ruffles her hair tips. She first looks up, then at the lens, whispering with suppressed awe:

"This scenic spot, the security guards are taller than mountains."

[4-7 seconds]

She stops to continue looking up. The orange glow on one colossus's chest slowly intensifies, its head rotates slightly; moments later, low-frequency mechanical sounds reach the platform.

She listens first, then confirms visually, her smile gradually fading. Her left hand instinctively steadies the nearby rock wall, pulling the phone slightly closer. She stops speaking, only taking a short breath.

Background travelers stop individually to observe, without turning heads uniformly.

[7-11 seconds]

Explicit hard cut, omitting transition journey: She has arrived at the gravel path outside the cave referenced in #4.

Light changes to gray-white daylight reflected from the cave entrance, with sheep, wooden fences, and scattered baskets behind her. She was walking along the path when a panicked ancient soldier runs past her left side, followed by two more rushing around the gravel.

She steps aside first, watching them suspiciously; then heavy footsteps sound, small stones on the ground tremble. She turns back to look at the cave entrance, rotating her body to reveal the giant's face between the rock walls behind her shoulder.

She whispers:

"Wait... they're not here to queue."

[11-15 seconds]

The giant squeezes toward the cave entrance, shoulders brushing off falling rocks, dust obscuring part of the wooden fence. The protagonist immediately stops speaking.

She first checks the escape route ahead, then follows the fleeing crowd quickly leaving along the path, bringing the phone close with her right hand, raising her left arm to protect her forehead. The selfie footage shakes with her footsteps, the giant only briefly appears behind her shoulder, not seeking full-body composition.

In the last two seconds, she moves sideways into a recess on the right rock wall, bending her knees to lower her body, supporting herself on the rock surface with her left hand. Ending shot: She leans against the rock wall, right hand holding the phone slightly upward at chest level, thin dust on her face, lips slightly parted, breathing heavily; the left edge of the frame still shows dust drifting from the cave direction.

Sound: High-altitude wind, low-frequency mechanical sounds; after the jump cut, replaced by sheep bleating, running footsteps, rolling gravel, giant's breathing, and her close-range panting. Only the protagonist speaks clear lines, background figures' shouts are indistinct.

Prohibit third-person tracking shots, aerial shots, floating phones, continuous direct gaze while running, sudden outfit changes, smiling explanations ignoring danger. The giant does not teleport in front of her.

At the start, the cats face the audience in a dim, phosphorescent club: soft green-cyan glows pulse across their fur, instruments, and the air around them. The lead cat steps to the center microphone and begins singing clearly in English while the other two play guitar and drums in sync. Their mouths move with the English lyrics, eyes intense and slightly wild, bodies rocking with the beat. Phosphorescent light trails and glows intensify around them as the performance builds. At the end, they hold the final note and pose together under the glowing lights.

entries.title: Baroque Archangel Michael Statue
entries.description: A detailed Grok Imagine prompt for generating a Baroque-Renaissance style oil painting of an Archangel Michael statue in a museum setting, combining Michelangelo and Bernini styles.
entries.prompt:
A masterful Baroque-Renaissance oil painting of a cream marble statue of Archangel Michael as a warrior angel, hybrid of Michelangelo and Bernini. Michelangelo-style idealized face, noble stern gaze, and carved wavy hair. Bernini-style dramatic movement with large sculpted wings fully spread and flowing carved drapery in heavy folds. Cream-colored aged marble with warm brown painted shadow strokes in the folds. A shining silver-blue metallic breastplate armor on the chest that gleams with cool bluish light. The statue’s right arm is fully sculpted and extended outward in a noble open-handed warrior gesture; the left arm hangs at the side. Museum-scale statue on an ornate carved stone pedestal, clear focal point of the room.
Around the pedestal stand four low, elaborately carved cream marble columns connected by a simple elegant metal chain, an interior museum barrier. Grand Italian palazzo gallery or Vatican-like cabinet of curiosities. Walls densely covered with 16th–17th century oil paintings in heavy gilded frames. An antique carved wooden writing desk in the foreground with papers, quill, inkwell, and a lit candle. Surrounding collections: globes, leather-bound books, smaller marble busts, wooden cabinets with artifacts, all secondary and slightly darker so the statue commands attention.
Warm golden chandelier and candlelight, rich Caravaggio chiaroscuro, violet-tinged shadows in the corners. Polished marble floor with reflections, coffered gilded ceiling. Cinematic antique oil-painting look. Highly detailed textures of marble, metal armor, chain, gold leaf frames, and aged canvas. No modern objects. No iron fence. No missing limbs.

entries.title: Realistic Noodle Eating Sequence
entries.description: A complex temporal prompt for creating a highly realistic 15-second video of a person eating noodles with natural movements and emotions.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly realistic 15-second video with natural human movement and believable timing.

0–4 sec: She slowly pulls the noodles into her mouth, naturally using the chopsticks. She finishes the bite and begins chewing.

4–7 sec: She chews naturally and visibly enjoys the taste, showing a subtle satisfied smile and relaxed expression.

7–9 sec: While chewing, she briefly looks to the left and then to the right, checking whether anyone around her is watching or laughing at her. Her expression becomes slightly cautious and self-conscious.

9–12 sec: She relaxes after realizing nobody is laughing, picks up the cup of tea and takes a natural sip.

12–15 sec: She puts the cup down, then casually wipes her mouth and cheek with the sleeve of her sweater, looks toward the camera and gives a small, slightly embarrassed but happy smile.

Keep all movements continuous and physically realistic. Preserve the exact person, face, hairstyle, clothing, objects and environment from the reference images. Natural facial expressions, realistic eye movements, realistic chewing and swallowing, accurate hand and finger movements, believable interaction with noodles, chopsticks and tea cup. Subtle handheld camera movement, natural breathing, realistic skin and fabric motion, warm natural lighting. No sudden movements, no morphing, no face distortion, no extra fingers, no duplicated objects, no unnatural mouth movements, no exaggerated expressions, no talking, no subtitles, no text overlays.

entries.prompt: 20岁东亚女性，女孩的形象不要变，舞姿和他们一样。粉白金渐变重工古风齐胸广袖流仙裙，裙身布满金线刺绣花卉纹样，轻薄通透的鎏金镶边纱质披帛，布料随风自然飘逸灵动，裙摆垂坠感十足，裙身点缀细碎珍珠挂饰，精致古风绣花软底布鞋，整体华丽温柔。裙子里面有内衬裤子，保证美女做抬腿动作时不会漏肉出来。舞动随风飘逸；轻盈灵动；黑色长发盘成古风发髻，搭配同色系精致头饰步摇，精致额饰，兼具明艳美感与飘逸气韵 初始姿态：单左腿站立支撑，右腿前屈，身体前倾轻靠右腿，双目低垂；右手抬至头部右上方，左手向后斜上方舒展。 1. 身体缓缓直立、微微后仰，右腿同步笔直向上抬高，双手枕于鬓角，肩部轻柔晃动，头部完整旋转一周； 2. 左手自上而下绕头一圈，右手自下而上环绕胸口一圈； 3. 身体转向左侧，视线低垂看向左下方，十指交叉挡于面部，双手缓慢向上下分开； 4. 右手大力向上甩至头顶，左手向下舒展，右腿向后划出圆弧扫动，借扫腿力道完整旋转一周； 5. 右腿落地承重，左腿后抬、小腿向内勾起，身体向后仰90度；保持姿态原地匀速旋转一圈，双眼轻闭、面带浅笑，双手手掌叠放于下巴处小幅左右轻晃； 6. 动作定格，双手同步自上而下划圆弧环绕上半身一周，左手略高于右手，视线跟随手部轨迹移动； 7. 双手拇指食指相贴、其余三指舒展，从胸前快速高举过头顶； 8. 身体转向右侧，上身微前倾，左手从头顶划弧轻落至下巴，右指尖轻扫眉梢后伸向右上头顶，手臂弯曲、手腕外压；双手轻晃腕间金饰两次，整套舞姿舒缓端庄大气。最后一个舞蹈姿势完成时，正脸缓缓回头看前方。 氛围与视听补充 画面搭配重金属鼓点配乐，节奏明快有力；体积柔光，细腻皮肤肌理，发丝、纱披帛布料飘动自然，鎏金配饰反光细腻，光影层次丰富，动态丝滑无卡顿。 负面规避词 模糊、低清、马赛克、畸形肢体、长短腿、扭曲五官、手部畸形、动作卡顿跳帧、僵硬布料、无飘动披帛、刺眼强光、杂乱多余杂物、水印文字、二次元、油画风、暗沉发黑画面、残缺饰品、光效杂乱突兀，生成15秒连贯视频。9:16。9:16。
