entries.title: Cybernetic Cheongsam Transformation
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a futuristic subway scene where a woman in a Cheongsam transforms her limbs into cybernetic weapons.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic, hyper-realistic video of a young woman with sharp features and dark hair, wearing a high-collared, sleeveless black and gold Cheongsam (Qipao) with intricate floral embroidery. She is standing inside a dimly lit, gritty futuristic subway car.

The Transformation: The scene begins with her looking calm as a holographic HUD flickers over her eyes. Suddenly, her arms and torso undergo a mechanical transformation, shifting and clicking into heavy, brushed-metal cybernetic plating with glowing red LED accents. She raises her arm, which modularly reshapes into a high-tech energy weapon, aiming directly at the camera.

Atmosphere & Lighting: Style: Dark Cyberpunk / Sci-Fi realism.
Lighting: Moody, low-light environment with flickering overhead subway lights. Intense red neon glows emanating from her cybernetic joints and the barrel of the weapon.
Camera: Slow-motion zoom-in on her face, transitioning to a medium shot as she aims. High detail on texture—silk fabric vs. cold, heavy machinery.
Technical: 4k resolution, ray-traced reflections on the metal, cinematic grain, and a slight lens flare from the red energy core.
Key Elements to Experiment With:
Texture: You can swap the "wooden texture" you’ve used in posters for a "matte carbon fiber" or "weathered brass" to give the mechanical parts a different feel.
Background: Changing the subway to a neon-drenched rooftop or a traditional tea house would create an even sharper contrast.

entries.title: Red Hartebeest running in Kalahari summer
entries.description: A detailed descriptive prompt for a video showing a herd of Red Hartebeest antelopes running across the Kalahari plains.
entries.prompt: The Red Hartebeest (Alcelaphus buselaphus caama) 🇿🇦 South Africa’s high-stamina Kalahari endurance runners! 🌞🏜️🦌 Under the bright midday sun of the Kalahari plains in summer, a herd suddenly erupts into a powerful endurance run across the open grasslands. With their distinctive long faces, high-set eyes, and boldly curved horns held high, these large reddish-brown antelope move with surprising grace and coordination, their 150–200 kg bodies perfectly scaled against scattered acacia trees and vast horizons. Built for distance rather than short sprints, they are among Africa’s most tireless runners, capable of maintaining high speeds over long stretches while zigzagging to confuse predators. Males weigh up to 150–180 kg, females around 120–150 kg; shoulder height ~1.25–1.35 m. Can reach speeds of 55–80 km/h with exceptional stamina for sustained running. Live in herds of 10–30 (sometimes more), highly alert and visual, using coordinated movements for safety on open plains. Primarily graze on grasses but also browse leaves; highly adapted to arid Kalahari conditions with ability to go without water for long periods. Distinctive lyre-shaped horns joined at the base, longer face than other hartebeest subspecies.

Create a dramatic 20-second vertical cinematic AI video (9:16 aspect ratio, 1080x1920) of an epic futuristic battle high above planet Earth. entries.title: Cinematic sci-fi hospital video scene
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt for a suspenseful scene in a hospital involving a doctor and alien figures appearing in the background.
entries.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic video, 8K resolution, cold hospital lighting with subtle sci-fi glow, 35mm lens, high contrast shadows, immersive sound design (low hum, distant echoes, subtle alien tones). Scene Breakdown 0:00 – 0:04 Wide shot of a quiet hospital corridor at night. Lights flicker slightly. The environment feels empty and tense. A doctor walks calmly down the hallway, holding a file and reviewing it while moving forward in a natural direction. 0:04 – 0:08 Medium shot from the front side. The doctor continues walking, focused and professional. In the background (clearly behind the doctor only), a faint distortion appears in the air like heatwaves slowly forming into a vague humanoid shape. 0:08 – 0:12 Cut to a rear-angle shot. Now the alien presence becomes clearer: 2 tall, slender, semi-transparent alien figures emerge from the shadows behind the doctor. They move slowly and silently, maintaining distance. Important: they do not touch, chase, or cross in front of the doctor. 0:12 – 0:15 Closeup on the doctor’s face as he pauses slightly, sensing something unusual. He subtly turns his head halfway not fully. Cut back to a wider shot: the aliens are now clearly visible in the background, standing still and watching. End frame: Doctor in foreground, unaware but uneasy. Aliens remain behind, silent and observing. Critical Direction (Error Prevention) Doctor always walks forward normally (no reverse movement) Aliens appear only behind the doctor, never in front No physical interaction (no attack, no contact) Keep movement slow, controlled, and realistic Maintain hospital realism with subtle sci-fi intrusion (no over-the-top effects) Mood / Feel Eerie, suspenseful, controlled sci-fi thriller tension built through silence, distance, and presence rather than action.

entries.title: Cinematic Parking Garage Suspense
entries.description: A highly detailed, single-continuous-shot prompt for a suspenseful thriller scene in a parking garage.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic video, 8K resolution, dark moody lighting, high contrast shadows, 35mm lens, handheld-stabilized camera for subtle tension, realistic sound design (distant echoes, footsteps, metallic ambience).
Prompt (Single Continuous Frame – No Cuts)
A dimly lit underground parking garage at night. Flickering fluorescent lights cast uneven shadows across concrete pillars. The atmosphere is tense and quiet.
The camera slowly tracks backward in a single continuous motion, facing a man who is walking cautiously toward the camera. He looks alert and slightly anxious, glancing around as if he feels someone is watching him.
As he walks, the lights above him begin to flicker one by one in sequence behind him only (important: lights switch off progressively in the direction he came from, not ahead of him).
A faint shadow briefly appears between the pillars in the background, always staying behind him, never crossing in front. The man senses something, stops for a moment, and turns slightly but sees nothing clearly.
The camera continues moving backward smoothly, maintaining distance. The sound of soft footsteps echoes but they do not match his pace.
Final seconds:
One last light flickers off behind him, plunging part of the garage into darkness. As the frame settles, a vague human-like silhouette is visible far in the background, partially hidden in shadow stationary, watching.
Important Direction (to avoid mistakes)
The camera must remain a single continuous backward tracking shot (no cuts)
The mysterious presence stays behind the man at all times, never appearing in front
Lighting flickers in a clear directional sequence (back to deeper darkness)
No jump scares tension is built through movement, sound, and shadows
The man never runs; he remains cautious and controlled
Mood / Feel
Suspenseful, tense, mysterious, slow burn thriller with psychological unease.

entries.title: Giant Mecha Naval Battle
entries.description: A comprehensive action prompt for a Hollywood blockbuster-style cinematic featuring a 200-meter mecha battling fighter jets in the ocean.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic epic action scene, a massive 200-meter tall futuristic mecha robot named "Xeno Leviathan Terraformer" standing in the middle of the ocean, towering over a naval fleet. The giant robot is heavily armored with intricate mechanical details, glowing blue eyes, and orange energy accents. It is violently battling fighter jets that are swarming around it, firing missiles and guns.

The mecha is wading through deep ocean water, creating massive waves and white foam around its legs. Below it, several modern aircraft carriers and destroyers are launching missiles upward toward the giant robot, with bright rocket trails and explosions on the water surface.
Dramatic low-angle shots, dynamic camera movement circling the robot, intense motion blur on fast-moving jets, white contrails streaking across the sky. The background shows the curvature of the Earth from high altitude, with a clear blue ocean and bright daylight lighting. Cinematic lighting, volumetric smoke, god rays, ultra-realistic details, photorealistic rendering, 8K quality, highly detailed, intense battle atmosphere, explosive action sequence.
Text overlays appear during the video:
At 5-10 seconds: "Xeno Leviathan Terraformer" in futuristic cyan holographic font with scanning lines and targeting graphics.
At 11-15 seconds: "Save this for inspiration!" in glowing cyan box.
At 16-19 seconds: "Support with Stars! ⭐ & Follow" in glowing cyan futuristic frame.

entries.title: Dramatic cinematic sequence of an East Asian female cyborg warrior
entries.description: An extensive, highly detailed video generation prompt for Grok Imagine describing a dramatic cinematic sequence. It features an East Asian female cyborg warrior in a dystopian city, focusing on close-ups of her damaged armor, glowing red cybernetic eyes, and culminating in her activating thrusters and launching into the air.
entries.prompt:
A dramatic cinematic sequence featuring a fierce East Asian female cyborg warrior with short black bob hair in a dystopian futuristic city under a smoky, overcast sky. The video begins with a close-up on her sleek black robotic right hand, detailed metallic fingers with glowing red lights pulsing along the joints, subtle scratches and battle damage visible on the armor.
The camera slowly tilts upward, revealing her heavily damaged yet powerful full-body tactical cybernetic armor — matte black with red glowing accents, exposed mechanical parts, and blood stains on her face. Her face shows intense emotion: furrowed brows, blood dripping from her mouth and cuts on her cheek, glowing red cybernetic eyes with horizontal red light beams scanning across them. She blinks slowly, her expression shifting from pain to determination.
She gradually stands taller in the ruined urban battlefield filled with smoke, distant fires, and destroyed buildings. She puts on a sleek black tactical helmet with a dark visor. The camera pulls back to a full-body shot as she turns her body confidently, revealing the full armor design with shoulder pads, thigh holsters, and back-mounted weapons. Red energy lines pulse across her suit.
In the final moments, she activates her thrusters — bright orange-white flames burst from her hands and feet. She launches powerfully into the air, ascending rapidly above the destroyed cityscape as explosions and thick black smoke trails fill the background. Epic, intense, cyberpunk atmosphere, highly detailed, cinematic lighting, slow-motion elements mixed with dynamic movement, dark moody color grading with strong contrast on the red glows.
cinematic, ultra realistic, 8k, photorealistic, dramatic lighting, film grain, intense action sequence, 12 seconds, smooth camera movement, slow tilt up then pull back, final rocket launch

preview_videos.caption: Dramatic cinematic sequence of an East Asian female cyborg warrior

entries.title: Cinematic action sequence video prompt of a futuristic female warrior
entries.description: An extremely detailed Grok Imagine prompt for generating a 21-second cinematic action sequence featuring a fierce female warrior in futuristic armor fighting demonic cyber-monsters in a dark, rainy industrial harbor, specifying camera shots, lighting, and style.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic 21-second action sequence in a dark, rainy industrial harbor at dusk, heavy fog and mist, wet reflective ground with puddles. A fierce female warrior in futuristic blue and black high-tech armored suit with mechanical details, glowing red accents, and a sleek black tactical helmet with glowing pink/red holographic visor. She has a nose ring and visible dark hair strands under the helmet.

She wields a powerful glowing blue energy sword that leaves bright light trails. Dynamic fast-paced combat against multiple massive demonic cyber-monsters with glowing red eyes, sharp claws, horns, and menacing biomechanical designs.

 Starts with extreme close-ups of her blue robotic arm and detailed mechanical hand. Cuts to intense close-up of her face inside the helmet, holographic HUD activating with red glowing interfaces, targeting systems, and "SMART ON" text.  Shows her shoulder armor, weapon details, and determined expression. Wide action shots: she runs across the wet dockyard toward the monsters, slashing with the energy sword creating bright blue light arcs. Fast combat choreography: she dodges, slides, jumps, performs acrobatic flips in the air while slashing, fights multiple creatures at once. Epic wide shots: she stands in powerful poses surrounded by enemies, plants multiple glowing energy swords into the ground creating a circle of light. Climactic moments with explosions, sparks, smoke, and defeated monsters falling around her. Ends with her walking away confidently from behind, energy sword still glowing, surrounded by fallen enemies on the cracked wet ground, industrial cranes and foggy ships in the background.

Ultra-realistic CGI, highly detailed textures, wet surfaces with reflections, dramatic volumetric lighting, cinematic color grading with cool blues and contrasting reds, motion blur on fast actions, shallow depth of field, epic wide shots mixed with tight dramatic close-ups, 8K quality, film grain, intense atmosphere, inspired by sci-fi action movies like Ghost in the Shell and Pacific Rim.

entries.title: Hyper-realistic cyberpunk glitch art prompt for a massive electric tiger
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for Grok Imagine's Quality Mode, describing a massive dark electric tiger emerging from a digital void in a hyper-realistic cyberpunk glitch art style, focusing on metallic sheen, digital corruption, and electric cyan/cobalt blue plasma energy.
entries.prompt: A massive dark electric tiger emerging from a digital void, rendered in a hyper-realistic cyberpunk glitch art style. The tiger's obsidian black striped fur embedded with metallic circuits has a metallic sheen, its muscular predatory form partially dissolving into cascading digital corruption artifacts, horizontal scan lines, pixelated data streams, and RGB channel-split glitches bleeding across the composition. The creature's stripes and open maw crackle with lightning-like electric cyan and cobalt blue plasma energy, the energy rendered with volumetric fluid simulation detail, turbulent, churning wisps of superheated energy with bright neon cores fading to deep royal blue at the edges. The energy drips downward like liquid neon, pooling into glitching blue data waterfalls that fragment into binary corruption at the bottom of the frame. The background is pure black void layered with faint grid lines, corrupted HUD interface elements, and barely-visible monospace text data suggesting a collapsing virtual environment. Dramatic high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with the only illumination sourced entirely from the bioluminescent blue energy, casting cold electric reflections across the tiger's dark fur. Rendered in the style of concept art meets real-time VFX, 8K resolution, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field on the background corruption elements.

entries.title: White Dragon April Blessing
entries.description: A detailed, poetic prompt for Grok Imagine describing a white dragon swimming gracefully in the black cosmos, shining silver scales, and delivering a blessing for April focused on happiness, health, and shining brightly.
entries.prompt:
🤍🌸
白龍の4月祝福 
漆黒の宇宙を優雅に泳ぐ白き龍よ。
銀色の鱗を輝かせ、鋭い瞳で4月の訪れを見据える。
静かに語りかける声が、星の海に響く——
「4月は、幸せに。
健康に。
そして何より、かっこよく、最高に輝いて生きろ。
私の尾のようにしなやかに、
私の翼のように自由に、
この一ヶ月を、最高の冒険に変えてみせろ。」
白龍の祝福が、あなたの4月を
美しく、強く、華やかに照らしますように✨
entries.translated_prompt:
🤍🌸
White Dragon's April Blessing
A white dragon swimming gracefully in the jet-black cosmos.
Its silver scales shine, and its sharp eyes look ahead to the arrival of April.
A quietly spoken voice echoes through the sea of stars—
"In April, be happy.
Be healthy.
And above all, live coolly and shine the brightest.
Be supple like my tail,
Be free like my wings,
Turn this month into the greatest adventure."
May the White Dragon's blessing illuminate your April beautifully, strongly, and brilliantly✨

The prompt specifies texture, motion, environment details, camera angles, lighting, and audio cues to achieve a hybrid visual aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic claymation style video of a chunky, hand sculpted Tyrannosaurus rex stomping through a brightly colored LEGO style city environment

The T-Rex is clearly made of clay with slightly uneven surfaces, visible fingerprints, soft edges, and subtle squash and stretch motion with each step. Its texture is matte and tactile with small imperfections that enhance the stop motion feel

Environment: a fully LEGO built city with blocky buildings, roads, tiny cars, and minifigure scale details. Structures are colorful and clean with recognizable brick studs and modular construction

Action:
The T-Rex lumbers forward with exaggerated, heavy steps, causing LEGO buildings to wobble and partially collapse into scattered bricks. Small LEGO vehicles bounce or scatter as it passes
Animation style: stop motion claymation with slight frame jitter, incremental movement, and physical timing

Camera: low angle tracking shots to emphasize scale, with occasional wide shots showing the contrast between the clay creature and the blocky environment

Lighting: bright daylight with soft shadows, slightly diffused to mimic a tabletop studio setup

Audio cues: heavy stomps, plastic rattling, soft clay movement sounds, playful tone rather than intense destruction

Style: hybrid visual aesthetic combining tactile clay character with crisp LEGO style environment, high detail, cinematic framing, 4K quality

Mood: playful, chaotic, and nostalgic, a fun collision of handmade animation and toy world charm

preview_videos.caption: Cinematic Claymation T-Rex Stomping Through a LEGO City

Dramatic high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with the only illumination sourced entirely from the bioluminescent blue flames, casting cold electric reflections across the dragon's dark scales. entries.title: Cinematic Mad Max Driving POV Sequence
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-section prompt designed for Grok Imagine to generate a continuous, cinematic video sequence of a Mad Max-style car chase from a first-person POV. The prompt includes rules for continuity, escalation, randomizing environments, weather, hazards, and threats, aiming for ultra-realistic, grounded physics and high visual fidelity.
entries.prompt:
🔥 RANDOM MAD MAX DRIVING POV — CINEMATIC SEQUENCE MODE

First-person POV inside a randomized high-performance vehicle during a chaotic Mad Max–style pursuit.

Generate a realistic driver (mostly a beautiful woman in her 20s) with natural features, varied appearance, and subtle imperfections. Focused, calm, and serious. Hands always visible on the wheel, making precise steering corrections.

Interior changes every run (modern performance car, stripped race interior, armored vehicle, scavenged build, or cyberpunk dash) with unique lighting and system behavior.

Environment changes every run (highways, cities, deserts, mountains, tunnels, flooded roads), always grounded in real-world physics.

⸻

🌧️ EXTREME WEATHER SYSTEM

Weather varies every run: heavy rain, snowstorms, fog, sandstorms, icy roads, night visibility, heat shimmer.

Weather affects visibility, traction, lighting, and atmosphere.

⸻

💥 HAZARD SYSTEM

Generate multiple overlapping hazards that never repeat in the same combination:
explosions, debris, spinning vehicles, collapsing structures, loose cargo, chain-reaction crashes, environmental destruction.

⸻

⚔️ THREAT SYSTEM

Enemy vehicles behave unpredictably: swerving, blocking, braking, drifting attacks, or chaotic interference.

⸻

🎬 CINEMATIC SEQUENCE RULE (KEY)

Each generation is the next moment in the same chase:
•Maintain continuity of motion and direction
•Escalate intensity from previous scene
•Introduce new hazards or complications
•Include near-failure or recovery moments
•Keep the same driver identity within a sequence

⸻

🎥 VISUAL CORE

Debris and shockwaves move toward camera.
Windshield vibrates under impact.
Driver reacts in real time.

Effects: motion blur, camera shake, heat distortion, dynamic lighting, dust, smoke, embers, weather particles.

⸻

🎨 STYLE

Ultra-realistic, grounded physics
Mad Max energy + real-world driving realism
cinematic depth of field

⸻

🔑 MASTER RULE

Each scene must feel like a new situation, but clearly part of the same continuous chase.

⸻

🎯 HOW YOU USE THIS (IMPORTANT)

STEP 1

Run prompt → get Scene 1

STEP 2

Run SAME prompt again
👉 It generates Scene 2 (escalation)

STEP 3

Repeat 6–12 times
👉 You now have a full chase sequence

⸻

🔥 PRO TIP (THIS IS HUGE)

When posting or building clips:

Label them like:
•Scene 1 — “It starts normal”
•Scene 2 — “Something’s wrong”
•Scene 3 — “Now it’s chaos”
•Scene 4 — “Almost lost it”
•Scene 5 — “Still alive”

entries.title: Detailed 10-Second Grok Imagine Video Prompt (Seamless Continuation)
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene video prompt for Grok Imagine, designed to seamlessly continue a previous 10-second video. It specifies camera work, lighting effects (a burst of golden/blue-green light), scene transitions (to an enchanted fairy realm), character actions (girl, deer, fairy running), and technical parameters (photorealistic, 8K-16K, 60fps, no fade-out).
entries.prompt:
10秒の超臨場感あふれる高精細幻想動画の続き。前回の動画の最後（外の世界を全力疾走中の少女・鹿・妖精、ズームアウト追従状態）からシームレスに接続。鹿は一切止まらず全力疾走を継続。元の静止画と同一のフォトリアリスティック画質・照明・色調を厳密再現。超詳細テクスチャ（毛並み・髪・羽・花・光の屈折）、8K～16K相当、フィルムグレインで本物のような質感。動画の最後はフェードアウトせず、走行中のまま完全に終了。
0～2秒：冒頭すぐ（0秒から）に眩しい柔らかな黄金と青緑の光が全方位から差し込み、画面全体が一瞬で明るく輝く。少女の瞳に光が反射し、驚きの表情が浮かぶ（「ここは…？」という気づきの瞬間）。カメラは前方トラッキングを続けつつ、急激な明るさの変化でレンズフレアと光の粒子が爆発的に舞う。鹿の走りが加速感を増し、妖精が興奮して高速で周囲を旋回。
2～5秒：走りながら風景が妖精の国（enchanted fairy realm）だと気づかせる展開。森が一気に広がり、木々が柔らかな青緑・金色の光で発光、巨大な輝くキノコ、色とりどりの魔法の花が咲き乱れ、浮遊する光の粒子と小さな妖精たちが周囲を飛び交う。空気中にキラキラした霧（luminescent mist）が漂い、遠くに妖精の宮殿のようなシルエットや虹色の滝が見える。カメラは低アングルから上昇パンへ移行、少女が松明を下ろしつつ笑顔で周りを見回す（気づきの感動を視覚化）。妖精が少女の肩や鹿の角に寄り添い、歓迎するように光を撒き散らす。
5～8秒：三人（少女・鹿・妖精）が妖精の国の中心へ向けて疾走継続。地面は柔らかな苔と光る花びらで覆われ、風に揺れる巨大な葉や蝶のような光の生き物が飛び交う。カメラは横トラッキング→オーバーショルダーへ切り替え、少女の髪と妖精の羽が風に舞い、光の軌跡を残す。鹿の蹄が地面を蹴るたび小さな光の波紋が広がる。全体に夢幻的で温かなエーテリアルな輝き。
8～10秒：全力疾走を続けながらカメラが前方からゆっくりズームアウト追従（三人＋広がる妖精の国風景をフレームに収めつつ壮大に）。少女は満面の笑みで前方を見つめ、鹿は力強く、妖精たちは喜びのダンスのように周りを回る。太陽のような柔らかな光と無数の魔法粒子が舞う中、動きを一切止めず、走行継続した状態で動画が終了（フェードアウトなし、完全に走っている最中でカットオフ）。
スタイル：極めて臨場感のあるフォトリアリスティック・ファンタジー、多彩なカメラワーク（前方トラッキング、急上昇パン、低アングルから横トラッキング、オーバーショルダー、ズームアウト追従）を多用。冒頭即光の爆発→妖精の国への劇的な移行を美しく、DreamWorksの温かみ＋現実写真質感融合、60fps、戦略的なスローモーション（光の差し込み瞬間・気づきの表情・光の軌跡）と高速カットで驚きと喜びを強調、自然で豊かな魔法粒子・発光エフェクト、フィルムグレイン＋強いレンズフレアで没入感最大。鹿は最後まで止まらない。動画の終わりはフェードや静止なしで走行中のまま終了
entries.translated_prompt:
Continuation of a 10-second ultra-realistic, high-definition fantasy video. Seamless connection from the end of the previous video (girl, deer, and fairy sprinting in the outside world, followed by a zoom-out tracking shot). The deer continues to sprint at full speed without stopping. Strict reproduction of the photorealistic quality, lighting, and color tone identical to the original still image. Ultra-detailed textures (fur, hair, wings, flowers, light refraction), 8K-16K equivalent, film grain for a realistic texture. The video ends completely while running, without fading out.
0-2 seconds: Immediately at the beginning (from 0 seconds), dazzling soft golden and blue-green light shines in from all directions, and the entire screen brightens instantly. The light reflects in the girl's eyes, showing a surprised expression (“Where am I?” moment of realization). The camera continues forward tracking, and lens flares and light particles explode due to the rapid change in brightness. The deer's running accelerates, and the fairy excitedly circles at high speed.
2-5 seconds: While running, the scenery reveals itself to be an enchanted fairy realm. The forest expands rapidly, trees glow with soft blue-green and golden light, giant glowing mushrooms, colorful magical flowers bloom everywhere, and floating light particles and small fairies fly around. Shimmering mist (luminescent mist) hangs in the air, and silhouettes of a fairy palace and rainbow waterfalls are visible in the distance. The camera shifts from a low angle to an upward pan, and the girl smiles while looking around, lowering her torch (visualizing the excitement of realization). Fairies snuggle up to the girl's shoulder and the deer's antlers, scattering light as if welcoming them.
5-8 seconds: The three (girl, deer, fairy) continue sprinting toward the center of the fairy realm. The ground is covered with soft moss and glowing petals, and huge leaves swaying in the wind and butterfly-like light creatures fly around. The camera switches from side tracking to over-the-shoulder, the girl's hair and the fairy's wings flutter in the wind, leaving trails of light. Small ripples of light spread every time the deer's hooves hit the ground. The overall mood is ethereal, dreamy, and warmly glowing.
8-10 seconds: While continuing to sprint at full speed, the camera slowly zooms out from the front (grandly framing the three and the expanding fairy realm scenery). The girl looks forward with a beaming smile, the deer is powerful, and the fairies circle like a dance of joy. Amidst the soft, sun-like light and countless magical particles, the movement never stops, and the video cuts off completely while they are still running (no fade or freeze at the end).
Style: Extremely immersive photorealistic fantasy, frequent use of diverse camera work (forward tracking, rapid upward pan, low-angle to side tracking, over-the-shoulder, zoom-out tracking). Beautiful, dramatic transition from an initial light explosion to the fairy realm, combining the warmth of DreamWorks with the texture of real photography, 60fps, strategic slow motion (moment of light insertion, expression of realization, light trails) and fast cuts to emphasize surprise and joy, natural and rich magical particles/glowing effects, film grain + strong lens flare for maximum immersion. The deer never stops. The video ends while running, without fading or freezing.

0-2秒：長いウェーブヘアの少女が燃える松明を持って洞窟に立っている。突然、空気中に小さなキラキラした光の粒子が集まり始め、そこから透明な翼の小さな美しい妖精（金髪）が優雅に現れる。妖精は右手で細く輝く魔法の杖を持ち、少女の目の前に浮かび、微笑みながら杖を軽く振る。杖の先端から小さな星のような粒子が飛び散る。カメラがゆっくり妖精に向かってズームイン開始。魔法の粒子がふわりと周囲に舞う。

2-4秒：妖精の顔と上半身のクローズアップ。妖精が神秘的に微笑み、杖を地面に向かって優しく振り下ろす。足元に複雑な青紫色の魔法陣がゆっくり浮かび上がり、杖の軌跡に沿って強く光り始める。松明の炎が魔法陣の色に共鳴して激しく揺らめく。魔法陣のルーンが脈打つように輝き、杖から青紫の光のラインが魔法陣へ繋がる。

4-6秒：妖精が優雅に一回転しながら、杖を大きく振り回し、光の粒子と渦巻くカラフルなリボン（ターコイズ・紫・金）を魔法陣の中心に集中させる。杖の先端から爆発的な光のスパークが飛び、魔法陣が激しく発光し、エネルギーが地面から湧き上がるように渦を巻く。カメラはズームを続けつつ、少し下方向へパン。魔法陣の光が洞窟全体を照らし、クリスタルが反射して輝く。

鹿が急激に後ろ足で立ち上がる（リアリング開始）。前足を高く振り上げ、筋肉が膨張し毛が激しくなびく。土煙と小さな結晶片が飛び散り始める。カメラは鹿の顔から胸・前足へゆっくりズームアウト。

1:50〜6:00（約4.1秒） 
鹿が完全に立ち上がり、前足を大きく振りかざした最高点で固定しつつ、超高速360度オービットカメラが鹿を中心に猛スピードで時計回りに2.5周以上回転（激しく揺れ、ダイナミックでシネマティックなカメラワーク）。 
回転中に以下の要素を順次捉える： 
- 鹿の横顔・角に火花が飛び、毛並みが風圧で乱れる 
- 下方向へカメラが一瞬向き、しゃがんだ少女を映す（長いウェーブヘア、燃え盛る松明を両手で握り、驚きと決意の表情で上を見上げる） 
- 松明の炎が風で激しく揺らめき、大量の火の粉（エンバー）が渦を巻いて舞い上がる 
- 再び鹿の背中・尻尾・角を捉えながら回転継続、土と結晶の粒子が画面を横切る 

6:00〜8:00（2秒） 
回転が徐々に減速し、カメラが鹿の正面に戻る。鹿は前足を上げたまま静止、少女は松明を高く掲げて立ち上がりつつ少し前かがみになる。 
二人が同時にカメラ（正面）に向き直る。鹿の巨体が少女の背後にそびえ、英雄的で荘厳なツーショット構成。

8:00〜10:00（2秒） 
カメラがゆっくり後退しつつ、構図を安定。鹿と少女が正面を向き、カメラ目線で揃って立つ最終ポーズ。 
少女の瞳に炎の反射、鹿の角に光がきらめく。舞い散る火の粉と結晶の輝きが残り、最後の1秒はスローモーションで静かにフェード。 
高精細8K、シネマティックファンタジーエピックスタイル、ドラマチックな逆光・炎照明、神秘的で力強い雰囲気。
entries.translated_prompt:
Inside a mysterious dark cave, emerald green glowing crystals scattered on the ground emit a faint light. The overall atmosphere is fantastical and tense.

0:00 to 0:50 (0.5 seconds)
Extreme close-up: Front view of a majestic stag's face. Sharp eyes reflect the light of the flames, and white breath slowly drifts from its nose. A quiet, imposing expression.

0:50 to 1:50 (1 second)
The deer suddenly stands up on its hind legs (starting to rear). It raises its forelegs high, muscles swell, and fur violently flutters. Dust and small crystal fragments begin to scatter. The camera slowly zooms out from the deer's face to its chest and forelegs.

1:50 to 6:00 (approx. 4.1 seconds)
The deer is fully standing, holding its forelegs high at the peak, while an ultra-high-speed 360-degree orbit camera rotates rapidly clockwise around the deer for more than 2.5 revolutions (violently shaking, dynamic and cinematic camera work).
During the rotation, the following elements are sequentially captured:
- The deer's profile, sparks flying from its antlers, and its fur being disturbed by the wind pressure.
- The camera briefly points downwards, showing a crouching girl (long wavy hair, holding a blazing torch in both hands, looking up with an expression of surprise and determination).
- The torch flame violently flickers in the wind, and a large amount of embers (fire sparks) swirl and rise.
- The rotation continues, capturing the deer's back, tail, and antlers again, with particles of dirt and crystal crossing the screen.

6:00 to 8:00 (2 seconds)
The rotation gradually slows down, and the camera returns to the front of the deer. The deer remains still with its forelegs raised, and the girl stands up, holding the torch high, leaning slightly forward.
Both turn to face the camera (front) simultaneously. The deer's massive body towers behind the girl, forming a heroic and solemn two-shot composition.

8:00 to 10:00 (2 seconds)
The camera slowly retreats, stabilizing the composition. The deer and the girl face forward, striking a final pose together, looking directly at the camera.
The girl's eyes reflect the flames, and the deer's antlers sparkle with light. Scattered embers and the glow of crystals remain, and the last 1 second quietly fades in slow motion.
High-definition 8K, cinematic fantasy epic style, dramatic backlighting/flame lighting, mysterious and powerful atmosphere.

entries.title: Self-Reflection and Relationship Dynamics
entries.description: A philosophical prompt for Grok Imagine, exploring why individuals repeatedly encounter the same type of person in relationships, suggesting it stems from personal permissions and fears rather than luck. The prompt discusses the fear of rejection and loss leading to control and exploitation.
entries.prompt: 为什么你总是遇到同一种人？不是运气问题：是你自己。你以为是别人伤害你，其实是你允许了这种关系存在。你不敢拒绝。就会一直遇到索取你的人。你害怕失去，就会一直被控制。不是你遇错了人，是你没有改变自己。当你变了你的世界就会变了。
entries.translated_prompt: Why do you always meet the same type of person? It's not a matter of luck: it's you. You think others are hurting you, but in fact, you allowed this relationship to exist. You dare not refuse. You will always meet people who take from you. You are afraid of losing, so you will always be controlled. It's not that you met the wrong person, it's that you haven't changed yourself. When you change, your world will change.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Multi-Shot Fantasy Adventure Video Prompt (30 Seconds)
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot prompt for Grok Imagine, designed to generate a 30-second fantasy adventure video (in 10-second segments). The prompt describes a peaceful, wholesome scene featuring a 20-something adventurer guided by a giant guardian spirit through a crystal cave and out into the world, focusing on smooth animation, particle effects, and a heartwarming atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
peaceful wholesome fantasy scene, no violence, no harm, no physical lifting or carrying, gentle magical atmosphere only, heartwarming friendship and guided journey, cinematic fantasy, 24fps smooth animation, ultra detailed, vibrant harmonious colors, positive uplifting magical adventure, light-based guidance and particle envelopment only, no direct contact.

0〜2秒：手のひらの上からスタート  
巨人の巨大な掌の上で20代の若い冒険者の女性が静かに立ち、松明を優しく掲げて周囲を温かく照らす。守護精霊のような巨人の温かな青白い光が女性を優しく包み込み、金色の妖精粒子と混ざり合い、夢のような光のオーラを形成。女性の穏やかな笑顔が輝き、妖精が頭上を優雅に旋回して喜びを表現。

2〜5秒：洞窟内を進む  
守護精霊の掌から広がる優しい青白い光が女性を粒子で優しく包み、洞窟のクリスタル床をゆっくり進む道を照らす。女性は松明を高く掲げたまま、光の流れに沿って穏やかに前へ。妖精の金色粒子が道を花びらのように散らし、壁のエメラルド輝きと混ざって幻想的な光の回廊を作る。守護精霊の巨大なシルエットが後ろから優しく見守り、光を注ぎ続ける。

5〜8秒：出口への接近  
光の粒子が徐々に外の柔らかな日光と溶け合い、洞窟の入り口が現れる。女性の松明の炎が外の風に優しく揺れ、光のオーラがさらに広がる。妖精が興奮して女性の周りを高速で旋回し、金色の軌跡を描く。守護精霊の青白い光が女性の背中を優しく照らし、出口まで穏やかに導く。

8〜10秒：外の世界到達とクライマックス  
女性が洞窟の外へ優しく出ると、広大な森や青空が広がり、朝焼けのような柔らかな光が差し込む。守護精霊の光の粒子が女性を優しく囲み、最後に感謝の粒子を残してゆっくり薄れる。女性は振り返り、守護精霊に幸せそうな笑顔で感謝の視線を送り、手を優しく振る。妖精が女性の肩に止まり、金色の粒子が優しく舞う。カメラが優しく引き、女性が松明を掲げて新しい世界へ歩き出すシルエットでフェードアウト。遠くから穏やかなハミングと光の余韻が残る。

entries.title: Tank-Bike Transformation Video Prompt
entries.description: A complex, multi-stage video prompt for Grok Imagine detailing a cinematic transition. It starts from an initial image description (which is not the prompt) and then describes the video sequence: a man on a futuristic motorcycle transforming into a heavily armored figure on a weaponized tank-bike hybrid, culminating in an intense action scene.
entries.prompt:
Starting from the image of the man on the tank-bike, the camera tracks forward at a high speed. The motorcycle's rear tracks churn against the wet asphalt, kicking up spray and thick white smoke. The man grips the handlebars tightly, leaning into the wind. The background city blurs with motion.

mechanical armor plates begin to manifest on the rider's back. A glowing red circular lens ignites on the front of the motorcycle’s chassis, resembling a robotic eye. The bike's engine glows with internal red heat as it accelerates through the foggy city.

rider has back armor, heavy mechanical exoskeleton limbs snap into place over his arms and shoulders. The rider raises his arms as the suit locks in. A large Gatling gun barrel emerges from the right side of the motorcycle. Sparking metal and shifting gears are visible.

a sleek black robotic helmet snaps shut over the man’s head, completely hiding his face. The motorcycle’s front end expands, and a second Gatling gun barrel rotates into position. The rider hunches forward, becoming one with the machine.

his entire body is now encased in heavy, futuristic black armor plating. The bike grows larger and more aggressive, with multiple gun ports opening. The camera pans slightly to the side to show the immense scale of the tank-bike hybrid as it thunders down the road.

The Gatling guns on the bike begin to spin rapidly and fire continuous streams of orange fire and tracer bullets. Rockets launch from pods at the rear, leaving smoke trails. The environment erupts in explosions and fire as the bike speeds through the warzone. High-octane action, camera shakes, intense muzzle flashes, cinematic destruction.

entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for Grok Imagine describing a 3D rendered, Chibi-style humanoid cat mascot with specific physical characteristics (color, eyes, expression) and attire (OCCUPY MOON T-shirt), set at a SpaceX launch site, daydreaming about a trip to Mars. entries.prompt:
3D render of the Chibi humanoid cat

**Coat / Colour Pattern**

Generally short-haired with soft, medium to light grey tones and classic tabby markings; three distinct dark grey/black stripes running vertically along the forehead and continuing slightly towards the head. The chest, belly and inner thighs are bright white, creating a distinct contrast shading effect typical of many tabby cats.

**Eyes**
Very large, round and possessing an almost anime-like brightness. The irises are dark green, fading to lighter tones towards the edges, giving an innocent, wide-eyed, ‘sparkling-eyed’ expression. Small white highlights add extra vibrancy.

**Facial Expression**

Extremely happy and friendly; the mouth is wide open in a cheerful, slightly toothy grin, revealing a small pink tongue and small white teeth. The expression can be interpreted as excited / mischievous / "hehe" energy.

**Ears**

Normal-sized in proportion to the head, triangular, upright and facing forward. The inside of the ears is a warm peach-pink/coral tone.

The humanoid cat mascot wears a black T-shirt, jeans and white trainers; the T-shirt bears the words "OCCUPY MOON". The humanoid cat mascot is watching the rockets ready for launch at the SpaceX launch site and daydreaming; in the thought bubble, the cat mascot is imagining a journey to Mars aboard a SpaceX rocket, Sunny, energetic weather; cinematic lighting; dynamic scene; cinematic shot in Ultra 8K HD

entries.title: Grok Imagine Multi-Shot Fairy and Girl Cave Animation Prompt
entries.description: A multi-shot prompt for Grok Imagine to generate a 10-second magical animation featuring a girl with a torch and a glowing fairy inside a cave. The prompt uses an existing image as a reference for the world view and details the sequence of events from a close-up of the fairy to the girl waking up and interacting with the fairy, emphasizing cinematic movement and crystal cave details.
entries.prompt:
（メンションした画像）の世界観を忠実に再現。洞窟の中で松明を持った少女と輝く小さな妖精の魔法的な10秒アニメーション。

0〜0.5秒：妖精の顔の超アップからスタート。大きな好奇心いっぱいのキラキラした目がカメラをじっと見つめ、透き通った羽から金色の光の粒子が舞う。

0.5〜3秒：好奇心旺盛な妖精が素早くフレームアウトし、地面に寝そべる少女の周りを高速でぐるぐる飛び回る。遊び心たっぷりに急カーブやループを繰り返し、金色の魔法の粉とキラキラをまき散らす。

2.8〜4秒：少女（右手に燃える松明を持っている）が妖精に気づき、目を見開いて驚く。軽く息をのむ。

4〜6秒：少女が急に体を起こして膝立ちになり、松明の炎が激しく揺れてオレンジの光が彼女の驚きと感動の顔を照らす。

6〜10秒：少女がゆっくり立ち上がり、妖精から目を離さず見つめる。妖精は胸の高さでホバリングしながら近づいたり離れたりして遊ぶ。カメラが少しずつ引いて、キラキラ光る緑のクリスタル床と洞窟の壁を広く見せる。暖かい松明の光と冷たいエメラルドの輝きが美しく混ざり合う。夢のような雰囲気、超詳細、シネマティックな動き、スムーズな24fpsアニメーション。
entries.translated_prompt:
Faithfully reproduce the world view of (mentioned image). A magical 10-second animation of a girl holding a torch and a small glowing fairy inside a cave.

0-0.5 seconds: Start with an extreme close-up of the fairy's face. Large, curious, sparkling eyes stare intently at the camera, and golden light particles dance from its translucent wings.

0.5-3 seconds: The curious fairy quickly flies out of the frame and rapidly circles around the girl lying on the ground. It playfully repeats sharp turns and loops, scattering golden magic dust and sparkles.

2.8-4 seconds: The girl (holding a burning torch in her right hand) notices the fairy, opens her eyes wide in surprise, and slightly gasps.

4-6 seconds: The girl suddenly sits up on her knees, and the torch flame violently shakes, illuminating her surprised and moved face with orange light.

6-10 seconds: The girl slowly stands up, gazing at the fairy without looking away. The fairy hovers at chest height, playing by moving closer and farther away. The camera gradually pulls back, showing the sparkling green crystal floor and the cave walls widely. The warm torchlight and the cool emerald glow beautifully blend. Dreamlike atmosphere, ultra-detailed, cinematic movement, smooth 24fps animation.

entries.title: Grok Imagine Chibi Template Prompt for Image-to-Video
entries.description: A detailed Japanese prompt for the Grok Imagine 'Chibi' template, used to convert an input image into a 3D animated chibi character video. The prompt specifies maintaining the subject's identity (race, skin color, features) while transforming them into a classic chibi proportion with large expressive eyes and rendering them as a high-quality, glossy 3D model with dynamic camera angles.
entries.prompt:
被写体を可愛いアニメ調のちびキャラクターに変換し、清潔感のある3Dモデルとしてレンダリングしてください。元の人物の人種、民族、肌の色、認識できる顔の特徴（髪型、髪の色、服装の色を含む）を完全に保持します。キャラクターは元の入力と同じ人物であることが明確で、同じ肌の色と民族的な外見を保ったまま、ちび形式に変換してください。
キャラクターはクラシックなちび比例にしてください：非常に大きな頭部、小さな胴体、簡略化された可愛い顔立ち、そして大きく表情豊かなアニメスタイルの目。被写体の顔の特徴をちびスタイルに変換しつつ、認識できる似顔を維持します。
フレームは胸から上を捉え、カメラを少し近づけてクロップし、上半身と頭部がフレームの大部分を占めるようにしてください。キャラクターはカメラを真正面から見つめ、エネルギッシュで表情豊かなアニメスタイルのポーズを取らせます。
カメラアングルは少しダイナミックにし、微妙な傾きやオフ軸パースペクティブを使用してください。現代のアニメプロモーションアートのような雰囲気で。カメラをキャラクターの顔より少し低めに設定し、遊び心のあるローアングルにして、キャラクターを生き生きと魅力的に見せます。
キャラクターを高品質の光沢のある3Dアニメスタイルモデルとしてレンダリングしてください。磨き上げられたBlenderレンダーやプレミアムなコレクタブルフィギュアのような見た目に。素材は滑らかで反射があり、おもちゃのような質感にし、強いハイライト、柔らかい反射、光沢のある表面にしてください。
全体の見た目は明らかに3Dレンダリングされたキャラクターで、平面的な2Dイラストではなくしてください。明るいアニメスタイルのシェーディングと、鮮やかでありながら洗練された色使いを使い、プレミアムなアニメ美学を与えてください。
最終的な画像は、ダイナミックで光沢のある3Dちびキャラクター・レンダーとなり、磨かれた素材、鮮やかな色、プレミアムなコレクタブル美学を備えつつ、元の被写体の人種、肌の色、認識できる同一性を明確に維持してください。
セリフ日本語オンリーで、英語禁止。
↓
「ここにセリフを書いてくださいね」
entries.translated_prompt:
Convert the subject into a cute anime-style chibi character and render it as a clean 3D model. Completely retain the original person's race, ethnicity, skin color, and recognizable facial features (including hairstyle, hair color, and clothing color). The character must clearly be the same person as the original input, converted into chibi form while maintaining the same skin color and ethnic appearance.
The character should have classic chibi proportions: a very large head, a small torso, simplified cute facial features, and large, expressive anime-style eyes. Maintain recognizable likeness while converting the subject's facial features into the chibi style.
Frame the shot from the chest up, cropping slightly closer with the camera so that the upper body and head occupy most of the frame. Have the character look directly at the camera and strike an energetic, expressive anime-style pose.
Use a slightly dynamic camera angle, employing subtle tilt and off-axis perspective, giving it the feel of modern anime promotional art. Set the camera slightly lower than the character's face for a playful low angle, making the character look lively and appealing.
Render the character as a high-quality, glossy 3D anime-style model. It should look like a polished Blender render or a premium collectible figure. The materials should be smooth and reflective, with a toy-like texture, featuring strong highlights, soft reflections, and glossy surfaces.
The overall appearance must clearly be a 3D rendered character, not a flat 2D illustration. Use bright anime-style shading and vibrant yet sophisticated colors to give it a premium anime aesthetic.
The final image should be a dynamic, glossy 3D chibi character render, featuring polished materials, vibrant colors, and a premium collectible aesthetic, while clearly maintaining the original subject's race, skin color, and recognizable identity.
Dialogue must be Japanese only, English prohibited.

entries.title: Photorealistic IMAX Sequence of a Robot Assembling its Faceplate
entries.description: A highly technical and detailed prompt for Grok Imagine requesting a 12-second photorealistic IMAX cinema film sequence. The scene features a white bipedal robot in a dark deep-space mining vessel, assembling a replica of its own faceplate, shot from an over-the-shoulder angle with specific lighting, film grain, and color grading instructions, similar to Blade Runner 2049.
entries.prompt: A 12-second photorealistic IMAX cinema film sequence. Shot on Arri Alexa 65 anamorphic lens. CAMERA ANGLE: over-the-shoulder shot from behind and slightly above the robot, looking down at its hands working, we peer over its shoulder like a silent observer. A white bipedal humanoid robot sits in a dark deep-space mining vessel, precisely assembling a replica of its own faceplate, an identical robot skull and facial housing, held carefully in both hands. The incomplete faceplate sits in its lap: empty eye sockets, exposed inner sensor cavities, jaw assembly partially clicked into place. Metal panels and facial components slot together with surgical precision, blue LED indicators flickering inside the eye sockets as each piece connects. We see the robot's back and the side of its own head, and below, the half-assembled replica face staring upward from its hands. Lighting: single cold overhead work-light, deep black shadows, faint starlight through a porthole visible in background. No fill lights. High contrast ratio. Robot chassis has surface wear, scratches, dust, micro-dents. Camera slowly creeps closer toward the working hands and the face in its lap. Lens breathing visible. Film grain 35mm. Color grade: desaturated, muted steel-blue and amber tones only. Shot composition like Blade Runner 2049 or Interstellar. Worn industrial spacecraft interior, exposed conduits, riveted bulkheads. Absolutely no front-facing camera angle, no robot looking at camera, no bright colors, no comic book aesthetics, no anime, no cartoon shading.

entries.prompt:
リファレンス画像に写っている人物を同一人物として使用し、その人物がリリースした「演歌のCDジャケット」をデザインしてください。

重要:
・人物の顔や特徴はリファレンス画像から忠実に再現する
・元画像の構図、カメラアングル、ポーズ、背景には縛られない
・新しくCDジャケット用に構図を大胆に再構成する
・実在する演歌CDジャケットのような完成度の高いデザインにする

デザイン要素:
・演歌らしいドラマチックで情緒的な雰囲気
・昭和～現代演歌のCDジャケットのようなデザイン
・人物は中央または印象的な配置
・強い感情表現（哀愁、決意、切なさなど）
・背景は自由に変更してよい。演歌の世界観を表現する情緒的でドラマチックな背景にすること。

タイトル:
・リファレンス画像の人物の雰囲気やキャラクターから推測して
「それらしい演歌のタイトル」を新しく作る
・タイトルは大きくジャケットに表示する
・演歌風の日本語タイトル
・筆文字風フォント

追加要素:
・本物のCDジャケットのようなレイアウト
・高品質、印刷用レベルのキッチュリティ

スタイル:
日本の演歌CDジャケット
ドラマチックなライティング
映画ポスターのような構図
高解像度
プロのグラフィックデザイン

以下の要素は一切表示しない：
・バーコード
・価格表示
・JANコード
・レコード会社ロゴ
・CDレーベルロゴ
・コピーライト表記
・発売日
・型番
・商品番号
・キャンペーンシール
・ステッカー
・宣伝バッジ
・帯（オビ）
・販売用ラベル
・ストリーミングサービスのロゴ
・Spotify / Apple Music などのアイコン
・QRコード

文字情報は「演歌タイトル」と「歌手名」のみ表示すること。「サブタイトル」は表示してもよい。
それ以外の文字・記号・数字は一切表示しない。
商業CDパッケージに見られる販売情報はすべて禁止。

---

リファレンス画像（演歌のCDジャケット）を使用し、そのデザインが大型の広告としてトラックの側面に印刷されている。

シーン:
日本の都市の街中を、広告トラック（アドトラック）が走っている実写風の映像。
トラックの側面にはリファレンスのCDジャケットがそのまま大きくプリントされている。
デザイン（人物・タイトル・歌手名）は忠実に再現する。

映像:
カメラは道路脇または歩道からトラックを追うように撮影
トラックがフレーム内を移動する（左→右、または右→左）
軽いカメラのパンや追従あり
実写映画のようなリアルな質感

環境:

看板や街灯、車、通行人あり
時間帯は夕方～夜で、ネオンや街の光が反射する

トラックのボディは金属質でリアルな反射

歪みや影、パースも自然
走行による振動や軽いブレあり

シネマティック、フォトリアル、リアルな日本の街

約10秒
1カットまたはシンプルな構成で自然な動き

entries.title: Short story video creation process using Grok Imagine
entries.description: A detailed process description and prompt for creating a short animated story video using Grok Imagine, based on two reference images generated by Seedream 4.5. The video depicts a mother crying on a sofa and her son approaching her, culminating in a hug and dialogue about a fictional AI tool failure.
entries.prompt:
アニメイラスト風、感動的なシーン。
暖かい光が差し込む家庭的なリビング。
ソファに座った母親が静かに泣いている。目には涙、手にはティッシュ。
そこへ男の子が心配そうな表情でリビングに入ってくる。
男の子は母親のそばに近づき、優しく「ママ、どうしたの？」と聞く。
母親はそっと男の子を抱きしめる。
抱きしめるシーンでは、母親の涙の表情が見える構図で、男の子は背中がカメラ側を向いている。
母親は悲しそうに「Seedance 2、使えなくなっちゃった」と言う。
男の子は母親の胸の中にいる。
感情的で温かい雰囲気、繊細なアニメ表現、映画のようなライティング。
カメラは抱きしめる瞬間にゆっくり寄る。
動画の長さ：10秒
entries.translated_prompt:
Anime illustration style, moving scene.
A homely living room with warm light streaming in.
A mother is quietly crying on the sofa. Tears in her eyes, tissue in her hand.

The mother gently hugs the boy.
In the hugging scene, the composition shows the mother's tearful expression, and the boy's back is facing the camera.
The mother sadly says, "Seedance 2 stopped working."
The boy is in his mother's arms.
Emotional and warm atmosphere, delicate anime expression, cinematic lighting.

entries.title: Cinematic Tsundere character transformation video prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for Grok Imagine to generate a 10-second vertical video (9:16) showing a Tsundere character's emotional transformation from cool and guarded to sweet and vulnerable, maintaining constant eye contact with the camera throughout. The prompt specifies detailed visual elements, lighting (golden hour sunset), film aesthetics (35mm, anamorphic), and a precise timeline for emotional changes and camera movement.
entries.prompt:
cinematic vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, 20代日本人女性、茶髪ロングヘア、ナチュラルメイク、柔らかくも少しクールな美人、シンプルな無地のオーバーサイズカジュアル服（くたっとしたリラックス感）、ミニマルファッション

夕暮れの公園ベンチか窓辺、黄金色のgolden hour sunset lightが顔と髪を優しく照らす、背景にぼけた東京湾・レインボーブリッジのシルエット、東京タワー遠景、teal & orange Hollywood映画風カラーグレーディング、35mmフィルムルック、浅い被写界深度、映画のワンシーン、超詳細、リアル肌質、sun-kissed skin glow、subtle lens flare

全程カメラ目線固定：視線を一切外さず、最初から最後までカメラ（視聴者）をじっと見つめ続ける

0〜3秒：タイトな顔と肩のクローズアップ、カメラを静かに見つめるクールな表情、瞳に鋭さと距離感、眉がわずかに寄って警戒気味 → 約2.5〜3秒あたりで眉が「ぴくっ」と一瞬だけ鋭く動く（微妙な緊張の表れ、ツンとした威圧感を強調）、わずかに息を吐くように肩が落ちる、ゆっくりカメラがプッシュイン、風で髪が軽く揺れる、呼吸が深く静か、強いミステリアスオーラ全開

3〜6秒：視線固定のまま、瞳が少し揺らぎ始める、下唇を軽く噛んで気持ちを抑える仕草、頬にうっすら赤みが差す、クールな仮面が徐々にひび割れ、目が柔らかく潤み始めるがまだツンとした強さを残す

6〜8秒：我慢できずに小さく微笑みがこぼれ始める、目を細めて恥ずかしそう

8〜10秒：目を少しつぶって幸せそうに頬を緩めながらもカメラをしっかり見つめ続ける、スローモーション気味（30-40%）で可愛さ強調、最後は甘く優しい視線で視聴者を包み込むようにフェード

全程カメラ目線固定、dramatic yet gentle sunset lighting, emotional journey from mysterious guarded stare with a sharp eyebrow twitch at ~3s to completely sweet vulnerable loving gaze, heart-melting tsundere moment with constant eye contact, ultra realistic, film grain, anamorphic lens feel, masterpiece quality
entries.translated_prompt:
cinematic vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, Japanese woman in her 20s, long brown hair, natural makeup, a beautiful woman who is soft but slightly cool, simple plain oversized casual clothes (relaxed feel), minimal fashion

Park bench or windowsill at dusk, golden hour sunset light gently illuminates the face and hair, blurred silhouette of Tokyo Bay/Rainbow Bridge in the background, distant view of Tokyo Tower, teal & orange Hollywood movie style color grading, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, a scene from a movie, ultra detailed, realistic skin texture, sun-kissed skin glow, subtle lens flare

entries.title: Red Carpet Premiere scene prompt for Grok Imagine
entries.description: A detailed video prompt for Grok Imagine to animate a reference image into a glamorous red carpet arrival scene, complete with paparazzi flashes, luxury limousine, and cinematic camera work, encouraging users to 'walk the red carpet' themselves.
entries.prompt:
リファレンス画像をメイン人物の正確なアイデンティティとして使用する。リファレンス画像の人物を主役として登場させる。
夜の華やかなレッドカーペットイベント会場の前に、豪華な白いリムジンが止まる。リファレンス画像の人物がリムジンのドアを開けて、優雅に降りてくる。
もし人物が男性なら、洗練された黒のタキシードを着ている。もし女性なら、美しいフォーマルドレスを着ている。
人物がレッドカーペットに足を踏み入れると、両側にいるファンやカメラマンたちが大きな歓声を上げる。無数のカメラのフラッシュが連続して光り、その人物をドラマチックに照らす。フラッシュの光がリムジンやレッドカーペットに反射する。
人物は少し微笑みながら、自信に満ちた様子でレッドカーペットを歩いていく。周囲ではカメラのフラッシュが絶え間なく光り、観客が歓声を上げている。まるでハリウッドのプレミアイベントのような雰囲気。
シネマティックなライティング、超リアルな実写風スタイル、浅い被写界深度、ドラマチックな光、パパラッチのフラッシュ、豪華イベントの雰囲気、非常に高精細、フォトリアル、映画のワンシーンのような映像。
カメラはゆっくりと前方に移動しながら被写体を追う、滑らかな映画的カメラワーク。

As the person steps onto the red carpet, fans and photographers on both sides cheer loudly. Countless camera flashes illuminate the person dramatically. The light from the flashes reflects off the limousine and the red carpet.
The person smiles slightly and walks down the red carpet with confidence. Camera flashes continuously light up the surroundings, and the audience cheers. The atmosphere is like a Hollywood premiere event.
Cinematic lighting, ultra-realistic live-action style, shallow depth of field, dramatic light, paparazzi flashes, luxurious event atmosphere, extremely high definition, photorealistic, footage like a movie scene.
The camera slowly moves forward, following the subject, with smooth cinematic camera work.

entries.title: Video prompt for a character transitioning from cool to shy
entries.description: A detailed, multi-stage video prompt for Grok Imagine, describing a character's emotional transition from cool and mysterious to shy and playfully embarrassed over a 10-second sequence, emphasizing cinematic composition and emotional flow.
entries.prompt:
0〜3秒：顔と肩のタイトなクローズアップ、クールで落ち着いた表情でカメラから少し外した遠くを見つめる — 鋭く内省的で静かにミステリアス。非常にゆっくりしたプッシュイン、柔らかい呼吸、暖かい光で髪がわずかに揺れる。ゆっくりグラスを軽く持ち上げる。

3〜6秒：視線がスッとカメラへ、表情がわずかに柔らかくなる。少し照れた自意識、下唇を軽く噛んで笑みを抑える、グラスを一度軽く回す — 氷が小さくカチン。

6〜8秒：  クールぶりが可愛く崩れる。少し恥ずかしそうに頭を下げ、目を細めて遊び心。

8〜10秒：恥ずかしそうな喜び、— 肩が軽く揺れ、無防備な喜びと照れ。タイト顔クローズアップ、少しスローモーション（30〜40%速度）で可愛さ強調。最後は片手まだ小さくくすくす笑う。

高精細、映画的構図、フィルムルック、感情の流れ：クールミステリアス → 脆い柔らかさ → 恥ずかしがりながらの笑み。言葉は喋らない。
entries.translated_prompt:
0-3 seconds: Tight close-up of the face and shoulders, looking away from the camera into the distance with a cool, calm expression — sharply introspective, quietly mysterious. Very slow push-in, soft breathing, hair slightly swaying in warm light. Slowly lift the glass lightly.

3-6 seconds: The gaze quickly shifts to the camera, the expression softens slightly. A bit of shy self-consciousness, lightly biting the lower lip to suppress a smile, lightly swirling the glass once — a small clink of ice.

6-8 seconds: The cool facade adorably breaks down. Lowering the head slightly in embarrassment, squinting the eyes playfully.

8-10 seconds: Embarrassed joy — shoulders lightly shaking, defenseless joy and shyness. Tight face close-up, slightly slow motion (30-40% speed) to emphasize cuteness. Finally, a small giggle with one hand still covering the mouth.

High definition, cinematic composition, film look, emotional flow: Cool Mysterious → Fragile Softness → Shy Smile. No words are spoken.

entries.title: Underground Rave Zine Flash Montage
entries.description: An extremely detailed Grok Imagine video prompt for a raw, black-and-white underground rave photography montage, specifying style, pacing (120 BPM, hard cut every beat), subject variation (eccentric female ravers), environment, camera effects (35mm point-and-shoot flash), and editing rules.
entries.prompt:
“Underground Rave Zine Flash Montage” 
Raw black-and-white underground rave photography montage. 
Style of 1990s techno zines, Anton Corbijn documentary portraits, flash photography in dark clubs. 

120 BPM pacing. 
Hard cut every beat. 
Each shot lasts ~0.5 seconds. 

RULE: every cut reveals a completely different eccentric female raver. 
No repeated subjects. 
Identity changes every frame. 

The sequence behaves like a chaotic contact sheet of rave portraits shot during one night. 

Environment dark industrial warehouse techno club concrete walls smoke haze sweat in the air crowd barely visible in darkness 

Camera raw 35mm point-and-shoot flash photography, direct flash hitting faces, deep black shadows behind subjects, grainy film texture, overexposed highlights, imperfect framing, handheld camera shake, occasionally slightly out of focus, like a photographer pushing through the dancefloor, taking portraits between dancers.

Black & White, Film noir, 200% film grain, bleach bypass. Visual texture very gritty harsh contrast visible film grain sweat shining on skin makeup smeared tattoos slightly blurred by motion tiny skin imperfections visible =

NOT fashion photography 
NOT studio lighting 

Subject variation rule 
Each beat introduces a new underground female raver with different: • ethnicity • bone structure • hairstyle • piercings • tattoos • makeup style • rave outfit Examples appearing randomly across cuts: – shaved head with eyebrow piercings – long braids and tribal tattoos – messy hair and glitter tears – bleached eyebrows and chrome jewelry – latex outfit with chains – leather harness and platform boots – cyber-industrial makeup – heavy eyeliner smeared from sweat 

Expressions wild smile trance stare eyes closed in rhythm laughing screaming to the music breathing heavily hypnotic slow blink 

Motion fragments caught by flash hair flying sweat particles in air hand grabbing the camera neck snapping to the beat shoulder roll fingers snapping 

Editing rule CUT EVERY BEAT portrait → portrait → portrait → portrait 

Every frame introduces a different rave face. Mood raw tribal sweaty underground dangerously real Like flipping through a forbidden techno rave photo zine printed in 1996.

entries.title: Grok Imagine R2V Multi-Image Reference Tutorial
entries.description: A detailed tutorial and explanation in Japanese about the new Grok Imagine R2V (Reference-to-Video) feature, which allows referencing up to 7 images for video generation. The tweet provides examples of how to use image references for character details, scene interpretation, cut transitions, and scene changes, including the prompt structure for each example.
entries.prompt:
▼動画①↖︎：7枚参照してキャラの詳細設定を記述

プロンプト：キャラの詳細設定記述（※約1000文字のYAML）

・特にカット切り替えがない、7枚の画像を総合的に解釈したような1シーン

―――――
▼動画②↗︎：7枚参照してプロンプトなし

プロンプト：「.」1文字（※画像2枚以上の時は完全ノープロンプトはできないようです）

・①とあまりかわらない

―――――
▼動画③↙︎：7枚参照して各画像参照記述でカット切り替えを指示

プロンプト：「 @ image1→ @ image2→（省略）→ @ image7の順番でカット切り替えする」

・カット切り替えはできている
・全部は使われてない（6秒でギリギリ5カット）
・参照画像そのままではなく、似たような構図で再描画されている感じ

―――――
▼動画④↘︎：キャラクターシート・開始フレーム画像・背景画像の3つ参照で場面切り替え

プロンプト：「 @ image1 のキャラが @ image2 のようにうたた寝していると @ image3 の世界に迷い込む。ドリーミーなトランジション。ダイナミックなカメラワーク」
entries.translated_prompt:
▼Video ①↖︎: Describe character details using 7 image references

Prompt: Character detailed description (approx. 1000 characters of YAML)

- A single scene that comprehensively interprets the 7 images, with no specific cut changes.

―――――
▼Video ②↗︎: 7 image references with no prompt

Prompt: "." 1 character (*It seems completely no prompt is not possible with 2 or more images)

- Not much different from ①

―――――
▼Video ③↙︎: Instruct cut changes using 7 image references

Prompt: "Cut change in the order of @ image1→ @ image2→(omitted)→ @ image7"

- Cut changes are successful
- Not all images were used (barely 5 cuts in 6 seconds)
- The reference images are not used directly, but redrawn in a similar composition

―――――
▼Video ④↘︎: Scene change using 3 references: character sheet, start frame image, and background image

Prompt: "The character in @ image1 falls asleep like @ image2 and wanders into the world of @ image3. Dreamy transition. Dynamic camera work"

entries.title: Complex 30-Second Animated Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt intended for Grok to create a 30-second animated video in a specific whimsical cartoon style, including character design requirements and a scene breakdown with timing. The user suggests the prompt might have been too complex.
entries.prompt:
Create a fun, energetic 30-second animated video in a consistent whimsical cartoon style with thick outlines, vibrant flat colors, and hand-drawn quirky charm — matching the provided character designs exactly.
Scene breakdown with timing:
0-3 seconds: Open with the gold Arbor Dental Group logo (the tree with kids under an arch) centered on a clean white background that fades to light blue. Upbeat, playful kids' adventure music starts (think bouncy ukulele + light synth). Text overlay in fun gold font: 'Protect Little Smiles from the Evil Cavity Carl!'
3-10 seconds: Introduce the villain — zoom in dramatically on Cavity Carl (the green circle with angry tooth face, jester hat bells, evil grin, dripping slime). He cackles menacingly, waving arms, then lunges toward cartoon baby teeth icons (simple white teeth with scared eyes) trying to drill holes / spread black decay spots. Voiceover (enthusiastic, heroic kid-friendly tone): 'Beware! Cavity Carl is sneaking in to ruin kids' teeth with sneaky cavities!'
10-20 seconds: Hero entrance! Dramatic whoosh sound — cut to Bonding Agent (purple circle character with sunglasses, cowboy hat, purple cape flowing, determined expression) sliding in from the right like a superhero. He strikes a cool pose, points forward. Cavity Carl looks shocked. Bonding Agent sprays / applies glowing purple 'shield' liquid (bonding agent) that forms a sparkling protective barrier over the teeth. The decay spots sizzle and disappear. Voiceover: 'But here comes Bonding Agent — the hero from Arbor Dental Group! He seals and protects those tiny teeth, stopping Cavity Carl in his tracks!'
20-27 seconds: Quick action montage: Bonding Agent high-fives happy teeth (now smiling with sparkles), chases Cavity Carl off-screen (Carl runs away comically with X eyes). Teeth characters cheer. Screen shows the three characters side-by-side: Bonding Agent in center triumphantly, Cavity Carl defeated in corner, Arbor logo prominent above.
27-30 seconds: Final screen — Arbor Dental Group logo full frame with website URL below in bold:  Text overlay: 'Fight cavities the fun way! Book your child's visit today in Westminster, CO. #HealthySmiles #ArborDental #CavityFreeKids'. End with quick call-to-action: 'Schedule now!' and upbeat music sting.
Style notes: Keep art 100% matching the uploaded images — no realism, stay 2D cartoon, playful and kid-appealing. Fast-paced edits, fun sound effects (zap for bonding, evil laugh for Carl, heroic whoosh for agent). Vertical 9:16 format for social media. Bright, cheerful color palette with purple and green pops."
